de dag ni sprul pa'i sku yin gyi sprul pa ma yin no/ /de dag gi gzugs brnyan gyi tshul du sprul pa byung ba ni/ gnas gtsang ma'i steng gi nam mkha' la gnas gtsang ma chen po 'og min gnyis pa dbang phyug chen po'i gnas su/ 'od lus rdzus te skyes pa'i tshul du sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku 'byung ste/ 'dzam gling bye ba phrag brgya rnams su sprul pa'i skus mdzad pa ci tsam ston pa thams cad des kyang gnas der gzugs brnyan gyi tshul du ston par mdzad do/ /'di ni mchog gi sprul sku chen po'o/ /nam mkhar zla ba gcig shar ba na chu klung bye ba phrag brgyar gzugs brnyan re re 'char ba bzhin du/ des mdzad pa bstan pa'i gzugs brnyan 'dzam gling bye ba phrag brgyar sprul pa'i sku 'byung ba ni/ sprul sku chung ngu yin te 'di gnyis ni sprul pa ni dngos te sku ni snang tshul gyi dbang du byas pa'o/ /'phrin las ni de ltar sku gsum po dngos dang btags pa ba de dag gis sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal zhi ba dang*/ 'gro rnams nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang bla na med pa'i byang chub rnams la 'god par mdzad pa rnams yin te/ so so'i skal ba dang 'tsham par sbyor ba'o/ /zhes rtogs par bya'o/ /de ltar gong 'og tu gzhi lam 'bras bu spyi don cung zad brjod pa 'di rnams ni gzhung chen po dag shes zin pa dang*/ da lta mi shes rung 'phral du slob par 'gyur ba dag la nges par bshad dgos pa ma yin kyang*/ gzhung rgya chen po slob par mi nus shing*/ chos kyi don rags pa go bar 'dod na phyogs 'di'i rab tu byung ba'am/ dge bsnyen nam kun spangs kyi spyod pa can thams cad kyis thun mong du 'don pa/ tha na bag med pa'i khyim btsun dang grong mi phal pa la yang grags pa'i mdo sde tshig gi shin tu nyung ngu 'di dag la brten nas/ chos kyi tshul go bar gyur na legs par mthong ste/ phyogs tsam smos pa yin la/

tshigs gsal por brjod mod kyang*/ don dbyings che bas sngar gzhung lugs mi shes pa dag gis/ dpe klogs pa tsam gyis ni go bar dka' yang*/ 'dir ji skad bstan pa'i don rnams shes pa'i slob dpon gyis yang nas yang du 'dzub khrid du byas shing nan tan du dpyad na rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /lnga pa phan yon dang bcas pa'i gzungs sngags bstan pa ni/ de lta bas na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngags/ zhes pa la sogs pa ste gong du bstan pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ye shes rgyal ba rnams kyi chos sku de'i rgyu mthun pa'i rigs sngags yin ces pa'o/ /rigs pa chen po ni/ 'dod pa'i don thams cad 'grub par byed pa'i don te/ dka' ba med pa dgos don 'grub pa'i thabs la rig pa zhes grags pa'o/ /bla na med pa ni/ chos sku rig sngags kyi rnam pa can de'i 'od lta bur 'jig rten du rig sngags byung ba yin pas/ rig sngags 'di yang 'jig rten las 'das pa ngo bo shin tu bzang ba 'di las gong na gzhan med pa'o/ /mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ni/ 'di las gong na lhag par lta zhog 'dra ba yang med ces pa ste/ dpes mtshon du med pa'o/ /yang na mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byed pa'i don yang yin no/ /yang gzhan don gyi dbang du byas na sems can gyi sdug bsngal thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i don no/ /chos sku mi brdzun cing bden pa grub pa de'i rgyu mthun pa yin pa'i phyir/ rig sngags 'jig rten du byung ba 'di yang*/ log pa'am/ brdzun pa'am/ bslu ba ma yin par/ rang gzhan gyi don mtha' dag sgrub pa la bden cing nges la/ yid ches par byed pa'o/ /de lta bur shes par bya ste zhes sngags kyi phan yon yid la byed dgos par bstan nas/ phan yon de dang ldan pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rig sngags 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis smras pa ste bshad pa ni/
tad+ya thā ni/ 'di lta ste/ ga te ga te ni gshegs pa gshegs pa zhes pa la gshegs pa'i don rtogs pa ste/ kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bden pa rab

£¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ tu £© rtogs pa'o/ /pa ra ni mchog ga te gong bzhin yin pas/ mchog tu rtog pa mthar thug gi gnas lugs rtog pa'am/ chos thams cad kyi gnas tshul du song zhing gshegs pa'o/ /pa ra sang ga te ni mchog tu yang dag par gshegs pa ste/ ji snyed pa'i chos thams cad la ye shes yang dag par song zhing rtogs pa de yang ji lta ba las g.yo bar mi byed pas na mchog go /bo dhi ni byang chub ste chos dbyings de nyid bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi ngo bo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /swāhā ni sngon gyi lo tsā ba rnams kyi gzhi tshugs shig par bsgyur te/ rig sngags de 'grub par smon pa yin la/ spyir 'di la don shin tu mang ba zhig bshad du yod de/ sngags bsgyur ba'i don ni de tsam yin la/ rigs sngags kyi yi ge'i 'bru re re'i phan yon ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes kyi spyod yul yin pas/ tshur rol mthong ba bdag lta bus bshad pa ga la nus/ dpe kha cig las/ sngags smras pa zhes mi 'don par sngags rig pa'o zhes 'byung ba ni/ uka ta dang yug ta'i sgra'i khyad par gyis yin la/ dri med bshes gnyain gyi 'grel ba'i lugs la ni/ gzugs sngags med cing*/ sngags su bstan pa'i phan yon rnams/ mdo tshig gong ma rnams kyi che ba bstan pa 'chad de/ 'on kyang 'di ni glegs bam ma dag pa'i skyon yin pas dkyus su bshad pa nyid legs la/ yang kha cig shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo sde 'di sngags kyi theg pa ston pa'i phyir yin zhes smra ba ni 'brel med cal col tsam mo/ /drug pa don bsdu'i phyir du sher phyin la slob par gdams pa ni/ shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sogs te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo mtshan nyid brgyad dang ldan pa de la mkhas pa'i thabs drug la sogs pa thabs tshul de lta bu'i sgo nas bslab par bya'o/ /gnyis rgyal bas mthun 'gyur sgo nas the tshom bsal ba ni/

de nas bcom ldan 'das sogs te/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis mdo 'di'i rgyas bshad zin pa'i dus de la/ bcom ldan 'das zab mo snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin de las gzhengs pa'i tshul bstan cing*/ gdul bya rnams kyis de ltar shes par byin gyis brlabs nas/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la legs so stsal ba ste/ legs so sbyin nas zhes bya ba ni/ mdor bstan yin la/ legs so legs so nas yid rang ngo'i bar rgyas bshad do/ /des na legs so zhes bya ba yin nas/ ji ltar legs so stsal zhe na/ legs so legs so zhes sogs yin pas/ nas zhes pa go rim snga phyi ston pa'i tshig ma yin no/ /de yang 'khor rnams kyi rnam par rtog pa la/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis bstan pa 'di yang zab cing rgya che ba yin mod kyi/ 'on kyang de bzhin gshegs pas dngos su gsung na ni/ 'di bas kyang ches lhag pa zhig yod do snyam na rgyal ba'i sras kyis bstan pa la ma gus pa zlog pa'i phyir ro/ /legs so gnyis smos pa ni/ ngo mtshar ba dang rtsod pa dang*/ khro dang zhum dang nges bzung dang*/ /dga' dang dad pa dag la ni/ /tshig gcig lan gnyis 'byung ba yin/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ / rigs kyi bu zhes ston pa nyid kyis spyan ras gzigs la bos nas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslab tshul ni de kho na bzhin yin gyi gzhan ma yin pas/ 'khor rnams kyis kyang spyan ras gzigs kyis bstan pa bzhin du slobs shig /spyan ras gzigs kyis chos bstan pa 'di la/ deng de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa nga nyid rjes su yi rang bar ma zad phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyang dgyes pas rjes su yi rang ngo*/ /rtsa ba'i gsum pa mthar 'khor rnams kyis yi rang mngon par bstod pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces sogs te/ sangs rgyas kyis mthun 'gyur mdzad pa'i rkyen gyis/ shā ri'i bu ni bdag gis dris pa don dang ldan no zhes dang*/

spyan ras gzigs kyang bdag gis bshad pa la yang legs par bshad do snyam pa dang*/ 'khor gzhan rnams ni de bzhin gshegs pas de ltar gsungs pa la/ dga' zhing yid ches pas de'i rgyu mtshan gyis spyan ras gzigs kyis yang dag par bshad pa de la shin tu yi rang pas mngon par yid brton cing glo gtod par byed pa'i don no/ /lha ni nam mkha' la spyod pa dang*/ mi ni sa steng na spyod pa dang*/ lha ma yin ni sa 'og na spyod pa dang*/ dri za ni de gsum char du spyod pa ste/ mgo tsam smos pas thams cad go ba'i phyir ro/ /thams cad dang ldan pa zhes pa la/ rigs thams cad dang ldan pa dang*/ kha dog sna tshogs pa dang*/ dbyibs sna tshogs pa dang*/ longs spyod sna tshogs pa dang*/ yul sna tshogs pa la sogs pa 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de na thams cad 'dus pa'i tshul du yod ces spyir bstan nas lha la sogs pa khyad par du smos pa'o/ /de tsam gyis ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyi shu lnga pa shes rab snying por grags pa'i mdo 'di nyid kyi dngos bstan gyi don rnams phul du phyin par mdzad zin to/ /mdo 'di la rgya gar gyi 'grel par grags pa 'ga' re yod pa las/ rgya skad du/ bi ma la mi tra/ bod skad du/ dri med bshes gnyen zhes bya ba/ rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi dus su bod du byon pa des mdzad pa'i rgya cher 'grel par grags pa 'di bzang shos su snang la/ phyogs 'dir byon pa chen po sngon rabs pa thams cad kyis kyang*/ 'grel pa 'di'i sgo nas 'chad nyan gyis gtan la 'bebs par mdzad do/ /'dir tshangs pa'i 'byung gnas gtsug lag khang gnas pa'i/ dge slong dge 'dun rnams kyi zhal ngor ni/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i snying po yi/ /rgya cher bshad pa dri ma med pas byas/ /zhes 'byung ste/ chos 'khor bsam yas la sogs pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyi don du mdzad pa yin skad/ 'grel pa 'di la bshad tshul mi 'thad pa yang ci rigs par yod mod kyi/

spyir legs bshad kyang mang zhing khyad par du 'phags pa'i yul du mdo lugs kyi bstan pa rnal ma yod pa'i skabs su byung ba'i/ sde snod 'dzin pa yang yin la bod kyi rgyal po byang chub sems dpas mchog tu bkur ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'grel pa 'di yang blta ba dang nyan pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas shes na legs so/ /'di'i 'chad tshul ni 'di ltar yod do/ /gleng bslang ba dang skabs dang ni/ /bstan par rtogs pa 'dus pa dang*/ /gleng gzhi dris dang lan btab pa/ /de ni rnam pa bcu gcig dang*/ /mthun 'gyur rjes su yi rang dang*/ /rnam par brgyad bsdus pa yin/ /ces 'byung ste/ dang po gleng bslang ba ni 'di skad sogs/ gnyis pa skabs brtsom pa ni dus gcig na sogs/ gsum pa bstan par rtogs pa ni dge slong gi sogs/ bzhi pa gleng bzhi ni de'i tshe sogs/ lnga pa dris pa ni/ de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus sogs/ drug pa la lan btab pa ni/ de skad ces smras pa dang*/ zhes pa nas/ de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo la bslab par bya'o/ /zhes pa'i bar te 'di la nang tshan bcu gcig yod do/ /bdun pa mthun 'gyur ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das sogs/ brgyad pa rjes su yi rang ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal pa sogs so/ /dri ba'i skabs ji ltar bslab par bya/ zhes pa la/ bsam pa dang*/ sbyor ba dang*/ mngon du bya ba dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ rtogs pa'i rnam pas ji ltar bslab/ ces lam lnga dang sbyar nas 'chad cing*/ zab mo spyod pa zhes pa la/ sbyor lam du mos pas spyod pa dang*/ de yang rang don/ gnyis don/ gzhan don gyi dbye ba sogs dang*/ sa drug la sgrub pa'i spyod pa ste bslab pa gsum la spyod pa dang*/ sa brgyad pa sogs la nges pa'i spyod pa sogs spros bshad mang du mdzad do/ /dris lan gyi don bcu gcig ni/ rtog bcas rtog med gzugs brnyan dang*/ /stong nyid mtshan med smon med gsum/

/sgom lam spyi dang spong ba che/ /bar chad med dang sems dpa' che/ /rtogs pa che rnams lam lngas bsdus/ zhor la sher phyin sngags su bstan/ /ces bya'o/ /tshogs sbyor kyi lam du rtog pa dang bcas pa'i gzugs brnyan lhag mthong gi dmigs pa dngos su bstan cing*/ rtog pa med pa'i gzugs brnyan zhi gnas kyi dmigs pa ni/ shugs la bstan to/ /tshogs sbyor gnyis su zhi lhag zung 'brel du sgom dgos pa'i don la/ gzugs brnyan rnam pa gnyis po de bstan to/ /de yang rang bzhin gyis stong par yang dag par blta'o/ /zhes pa yan chad do/ /de nas mthong lam gyi dmigs pa rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum yin la/ de la gzugs stong pa'o sogs kyis stong nyid dang*/ mtshan nyid med pa sogs kyis mtshan ma med pa dang bri ba med pa sogs kyis smon pa med pa ste/ dmigs rnam gsum po de goms pas mtshan nyid la sogs pa'i zhen pa bdun logs pa'i tha snyad mdzad do/ /sgo lam gyi dmigs rnam dngos ni/ de lta bas na stong pa nyid la gzugs med sogs so/ /de'i 'bras bu spong ba che ba ni/ sems la sgrib pa med sogs te/ de gnyis sgom lam gyi dbang du byas pa'o/ /bar chad med pa'i lam dngos ni/ dus gsum du sogs so/ /de'i 'bras bu sems dpa' che ba ni bla na med pa zhes so/ /rtog pa che ba ni yang dag par zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /don tshan bcu gcig po ni de dag yin la/ de lta bas na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngags zhes sogs so/ /bcu gcig la mi bgrong bar zhar byung sher phyin sngags su bstan pa zhes bya ste/ lam lnga sogs bshad tshul 'di dngos bstan tshig zin ma yin par/ sbas don mngon rtogs kyi rim pa yin la/ dngos po brgyad dang sbyor tshul mi 'dug kyang*/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi bshad sgros dang bstun nas 'chad par snang zhing*/ 'grel pa de na spyi khyab tu nye bar mkho ba'i bshad sgros kyang mang snang ngo*/

/blo gros zhan pas 'grel pa de mthong yang go dka' bar gyur na/ lugs de ni zhib cing gsal la ma nor bar ar byang chub ye shes kyi 'grel pa na bkod 'dug pas der blta bar bya'o/ /da ni sbas don mngon rtogs kyi rim pa/ bdag gi rnam par rtog pa dang sbyar na/ dngos po brgyad kyi rim pa dang yang 'byor bar mthong ste/ de ltar yang rgyal tshab chen pos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan las/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni/ /dngos po brgyad kyis yang dag bshad/ /rnam kun mkhyen nyid lam shes nyid/ /de nas thams cad shes pa nyid/ /rnam kun mngon rdzogs rtogs pa dang*/ rtse mor phyin dang mthar gyis pa/ /skad cig gcig mngon rdzogs byang chub/ /chos kyi sku dang de rnams brgyad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar te/ 'dir dngos po brgyad ces pa la/ dngos po'i don ni/ dngos po dngos med ces pa lta bu'i skabs kyi dngos po la mi zer gyi/ brjod don tsam zhig la dngos po'i sgra 'jug pa'i skabs yin pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo'i brjod bya'i don yin pa'i ming ste/ don gyi gtso bo brgyad po 'di yin ces pa'i don no/ /spyir sher mdo tsam gyi brjod bya'i don gyi gtso bo mthar thug gi dbang du byas na/ brgyad po'i nang nas kyang chos sku kho na yin mod kyi/ mdo gzhung la/ sde tshan dum bu brgyad du phye na/ brgyad kar don gyi gtso bor bya ste/ dper na lam shes kyi mdo'i brjod bya'i don gyi gtso bo lam shes nyid la bya dgos pa bzhin no/ /de yang mdo tshig de dag gis dngos su bstan pa'i brjod bya'i dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ gzhan du na/ lam shes kyang 'bras bu chos sku thob byed kyi thabs yin pa'i phyir/ shugs bstan dang*/ brgyud nas ston pa'i dbang du byas na/ de dag gi yang don gyi gtso bo chos sku yin no/ /de la dngos po brgyad ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang*/

lam thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang*/ gzhi thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang*/ rnam pa kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ rtse mor phyin pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ skad cig gcig gis mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ 'bras bu shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa chos kyi sku rnams so/ /de dag kyang yul mkhyen pa gsum/ nyams len sbyor ba bzhi/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku zhes gsum du yang bsdu bar bya zhing*/ yang mkhyen pa gsum ni gtan la dbab bya yin pas mtshan nyid ces bya la/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba ni/ mtshan nyid dang mthun par/ nyams su len pa'i rim pa yin pas de'i sbyor ba dang*/ rtse mo'i sbyor ba ni sa lam rang rang so so'i ye shes de nyid byang ba'i skabs yin pas sbyor ba rab tu son pa dang*/ mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba ni/ rang rang so so'i lam gyi goms pa de nyid brtan pa yang byed cing rtsal phyogs med du 'phel ba'i phyir/ go rim mi 'dra ba du ma la slob pa yin pas rab tu son pa de'i go rim zhes bya la/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba ni/ go rim de'am/ sbyor ba gsum po de thams cad kyi nus pa dus gcig tu bsgril ba'i skabs yin pas/ go rim gyi mtha' 'am yang na sbyor ba thams cad kyi mtha' zhes bya'o/ /chos kyi sku ni lam thams cad kyi grub don rtsol med shugs 'byung gi tshul du gnas pas/ mtha' de'i rnam smin ces bya'o/ /des na sher phyin gyi mtshan nyid/ sher phyin gyi sbyor ba/ sbyor ba rab tu son pa/ go rim gyi sbyor ba/ mtha'i sbyor ba/ rnam smin mthar thug ste/ don tshan drug tu yang 'dus so/ /de ltar yang*/ mtshan nyid de yi sbyor ba dang*/ /de rab de yi go rim dang*/ /de mtha' de yi rnam smin ni/ /don bsdus gzhan te rnam pa drug /yul ni rnam pa gsum po rgyu/ /sbyor ba bzhi yi bdag nyid can/ /chos sku 'phrin las 'bras bu ni/

/don bsdus gzhan te rnam pa gsum/ /zhes so/ /de la yul ces bya ba ni/ sbyor ba bzhi po'i dmigs pa'i yul yin/ de yang mkhyen pa gsum ma thob pa rnams kyis/ mkhyen gsum la dngos su ni dmigs mi thub la/ mtshan nyid 'di dang 'di lta bu dag ni rnam mkhyen no/ /zhes sgra don 'dres par bzung ste rnam mkhyen gyi mtshan nyid yang yang yid la dran pa tsam gy-is ni de la dmigs par yang mi 'gyur bas/ 'dir mkhyen pa gsum gyi rtogs bya gang yin pa de/ sbyor ba bzhi'i dmigs pa'i yul du 'jog pa yin te/ de'i phyir mkhyen gsum yang brgyud nas yul du bzhag go /rgyu zhes bya ba ni skyed byed kyi rgyu dang*/ rgyu mtshan gnyis la skabs thob kyi 'jug shul so sor yod pa las/ 'dir ni gnyis ka ltar mi 'gal te/ gtso bor ni rnam pa dang lam dang gzhi gsum la spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i rnam pa de nyid dmigs pa'i yul dang rgyu mtshan du byas nas 'jog dgos pa'i phyir rgyu'i don rgyu mtshan du byas la/ dmigs yul de la dmigs nas bsgoms pas ye shes skye ba ni/ dmigs yul de ye shes de'i bskyed rgyu dngos min yang*/ bskyed rgyu dang rnam pa mtshungs pas skyed byed kyi rgyu'i tshul du bshad kyang rung ngo*/ /yang rnam pa gcig tu na/ ji skad du/ sangs rgyas las chos chos las 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /tshogs las snying po ye shes khams thob mthar/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dngos bstan ltar/ sangs rgyas byang sems sogs kyi thugs rgyud kyi mkhyen pa gsum gyis rgyu mthun pa'i chos bskyed cing*/ des gdul bya'i rgyud la sbyor gzhi sogs bskyed par byas kyang rung ngo*/ /de dag las mkhyen pa gsum ni/ ji skad du/ nyi khri lnga stong pa las/ rab 'byor thams cad shes pa nyid ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi yin no/ /lam shes pa nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yin no/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni/

de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi yin no/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ rgyal tshab chen po'i bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan las kyang*/ thub pa'i rnam kun mkhyen pa nyid/ /ces dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' mkhas rnams kyi/ /lam shes nyid ni de 'drar bshad/ /ces dang*/ nyan thos la sogs mthong ba'i lam/ de 'dra kun shes nyid du 'dod/ /ces 'byung ba sogs kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes ni rnam mkhyen dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi ye shes ni lam shes dang*/ nyan rang 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi ye shes ni gzhi shes so zhes kyang rags bshad du bya la/ 'di la 'ga' zhig ni/ rnam mkhyen gang yin lam shes yin la/ lam shes gang yin gzhi shes yin te/ shes bya thams cad mkhyen phyin lam skye med du ma rtogs pa mi srid la/ lam gsum ka rtogs phyin gang zag gi bdag med ma rtogs pa mi srid pas/ rten gyi gang zag su'i rgyud la yod kyang rung ste/ lam gsum skye med du rtogs pa yin phyin chad lam shes yin cing*/ gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa yin phyin chad gzhi shes kyang yin pas so/ /'on kyang tshur tshur la ni ma khyab ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud kyi lam shes ni/ rnam mkhyen ma yin cing*/ nyan rang gi gzhi shes kyang mkhyen pa gzhan gnyis ma yin no/ /zhes zer ro/ /la la dag ni/ mkhyen pa gsum po ngo bo mi gcig pa lta ci smos rgyud gcig la yang mi gnas te/ rten so sor nges par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /des na sangs rgyas kyis lam dang gzhi skye med du gzigs kyang de rnam mkhyen kho na yin gyi gzhan ma yin no/ /zhes sems par byed do/ /gzhan dag ni yon tan yar ldan yin pas/ nyan rang ni gzhi shes gcig pu dang ldan la/ byang sems ni de'i steng du lam shes dang yang ldan cing*/ sangs rgyas ni mkhyen pa gsum ka dang ldan pas/ rgyud gcig la gsum mam gnyis 'jug pa ni yod kyang*/

gsum po dngos po ni tha dad yin no zhes smra'o/ /de dag las mang po zhig ni/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam mkhyen byang sems kyi lam shes/ nyan rang gi gzhi shes rnams mtshan nyid pa dngos yin la/ byang sems kyis gang zag gi bdag med mthong ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyis lam dang gzhi skye med du gzigs pa ni/ de dang de btags pa ba yin no/ /zhes rgyu mtshan du ma dang bcas te brjod pa dang*/ kha cig ni mkhyen pa gsum ka yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin pas/ sangs rgyas kyi gsum kar mtshan nyid pa yin pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i lam dang gzhi shes pa mtshan nyid pa yin la/ nyan rang gi gzhi shes ni/ spros pa phyogs gcig tsam bkag pa las/ gzhan spros bral gyi rnam pa can ma yin pas btags pa ba'o/ /zhes rgyu mtshan du ma dang bcas te 'bri bar byed do/ /gzhan la la dag ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang*/ sangs rgyas kho na'i rgyud la yod do zhes dang*/ kha cig ni rnam mkhyen yang rnam pa gnyis te rgyu dang 'bras bu'o/ /rgyu'i rnam mkhyen ni/ byang chub sems dpa' kho na'i rgyud la yod de/ skabs dang po'i rnam mkhyen yang 'di kho na yin la sems bskyed sogs bcu po yang rnam mkhyen nyid yin pa dang*/ 'bras bu'i rnam mkhyen ni chos sku'o zhes zer ba dang*/ kha cig ni sems bskyed sogs chos bcu po dngos po brgyad kyi rnam mkhyen ma yin te/ mtshon byed kyi chos sam dmigs pa'i yul yin no/ /zhes 'dod pa dang*/ gzhan kha cig ni mdo dang rgyan gyi mchod brjod dang*/ bstan bcos dngos kyi mdor bstan rgyas bshad sogs la mkhyen gsum gyi 'jog mtshams mi 'dra ba re re yin no zes blun gtam du smra ba sogs/ bstan pa lnga brgya tha ma la/ rgya bod gnyis kar du 'di'i lag len dang sgrub dka' ni shin tu phra ba bshad pa tsam zhig ni ha cang dar ches pas/ rnam pa du mar 'chol bas yin la/ phyogs re nas bltas na/

thams cad la 'gal ba cher med pa ltar snang zhing*/ phyogs cig shos nas bltas na/ re re zhing skyon du ma 'jug par lta yang snang bas zhib tu dpyad dgos kyang*/ re zhig 'dir rgya mi bskyed do/ /de la dngos po dang po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa ni/ mdo las bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi lags/ rab 'byor rnam pa gang dag dang*/ rtags gang dag dang*/ mtshan ma gang dag gi chos rnams rab tu brjod pa'i/ rnam pa de dag dang*/ rtags de dag dang*/ mtshan ma de dag de bzhin gshegs pas thugs su chud de/ de'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ces bya'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ de la rnam pa ni ngo bo dang*/ rtags ni 'bras bu dang*/ mtshan ma ni rgyu'i don yin pas/ ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i shes bya thams cad kyi rang rang so so'i ngo bo rnams dang*/ so so rnams kyi 'bras bu rnams dang*/ de dang de'i rgyu rkyen thams cad de/ bskyed bya skyed byed kyi rgyu 'bras dang*/ rnam par gzhag bya 'jog byed kyi rgyu 'bras thams cad do/ /de 'dra de rnams ye shes gcig gis cig char mkhyen pas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid do/ /de yang ji lta ba'i mkhyen tshul gyis ni chos thams cad kyi rgyu 'bras ngo bo gsum spros bral du mkhyen cing*/ ji snyed gzigs pa'i ye shes kyis ni/ shes bya thams cad kyi ngo bo rgyu 'bras kyi rnam 'gyur thams cad kyang mkhyen pa yin no/ /de yang rnam pa thams cad rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal bar gzigs pa yin la/ rnam pa skye med ces sam/ rnam pa rang bzhin med pa zhes 'chad pa yang rang bzhin 'od gsal dang don gcig pas/ rnam grangs su bshad na mi 'ga' yang brjod tshul legs po kho nar yang mi 'dug pas/ skye med dang rang bzhin med ces pa'i bzlas brjod kho na la/

bzang por zhen pa yang mi mdzes so/ /sangs rgyas kyi ye shes rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pas ma dag pa'i rnam brtags mtshan ma gsum po dngos su gzigs pa ni ma yin te/ chos can kun rdzob pa'i snang ba thams cad gdod nas ma grub pa'i phyir/ gnas tshul la ma grub pa de nyid gzigs na/ ye she 'khrul bar thal ba'i phyir ro/ /gang yod pa mi mthong ba dang*/ med pa mthong ba ni 'khrul zhing rmongs pa kho na yin no/ /des na ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa gnyis ka shes bya thams cad kyi gnas tshul rtag brtan zhi ba g.yung drung gi ye shes bde ba dam pa'i ngo bor gnas pa gzigs pa gzhir bzhag pa las/ de nyid la dngos po dngos med yul yul can/ 'khor ba dang*/ lam dang*/ 'bras bu gsar thob sogs 'jig rten pa dang rnal 'byor pa rnams la dngos su snang ba dang*/ dngos su mi snang yang*/ blos bzhag pa'i chos gang yang yod ma myong ba zhi ba'i mtshan nyid de/ snang mkhan dang 'jog mkhan gyi shes pa kun nas nyon mongs pa thams cad kyang gdod nas med pa'i phyir rnam par dag pa/ rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba mnyam nyid yin par rtogs pa de ni ji ltar ba mkhyen tshul yin la/ rang bzhin 'od gsal gyi sems nyid de/ don dam pa'i rnam pa thams cad pa yin pa'i phyir/ shes bya thams cad kyi rnam pa don dam pa de/ kun rdzob kyi shes bya thams cad kyi yang gnas lugs dang chos nyid du yod cing de ltar yod pa mkhyen pa ni ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes so/ /don dam srid gsum dngos su gzigs kyang de kun rdzob kyi snang ba ma yin cing*/ kun rdzob srid gsum dngos su ma gzigs kyang*/ sems can rnams la de snang ba dang*/ de rnams kyi 'khrul ngor bde sdug sogs 'byung ba mkhyen no/ /ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i rtogs tshul gnyis kar rang rig gi tshul gyis mkhyen pa yin pas/ don dam pa'i rnam brtags mtshan ma rnams/ rang bzhin 'od gsal nyid yin la/

don dam pa'i rnam brtags mtshan ma gsum mkhyen pa dang*/ 'od gsal de nyid rnam pa thams cad pa yin pa don gcig la 'du'o/ /de ltar yang rgyal tshab chen pos/ 'gro ba zhi ba'i chos nyid du/ /rtogs phyir ji ltar nyid de yang*/ /rang bzhin kyis ni yongs dag phyir/ /nyon mongs gdod nas zad phyir ro/ /shes bya mthar thug rtogs pa'i blos/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos nyid ni/ /sems can thams cad la yod par/ /mthong phyir ji snyed yod pa nyid/ /ces ji lta ji snyed kyi rtogs tshul de ltar yin par gsungs la/ kha cig sangs rgyas kyis ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad gzigs kyang*/ bden 'dzin med pas ma 'khrul ba yin no skad zer ba ni/ skyes bu 'di ni chom pos bzung bas cho nges 'debs mod kyi/ nor 'phrog rgyu med pas sdug bsngal med do zhes zer ba dang*/ sgyu ma'i cha sgyus shes pa'i mi 'dis ni/ sgyu ma sprul pa'i khang pa mthong mod kyi/ sgyu mar shes pa'i phyir ma 'khrul lo/ /zhes zer ba dang 'dra ste/ cho nges 'debs pa nyid sdug bsngal thob pa'i rtags yin pa dang*/ sgyu ma'i khang bzang mthong ba nyid dbang po bslad pa'i 'khrul ba yin na/ 'khrul ba'i ngos 'dzin blos bcom ma gzhan zhig gsar du rnam par bzhag nas/ de med pas 'khrul ba med do zhes brjod kyang mi mdzes pa ltar/ gang mi rtag pa dang*/ sdug bsngal ba dang*/ gzugs sogs su snang ba de nyid 'khrul ba yin pas/ de la bden par mi 'dzin no zhes smras pas ci zhig bya/ de ltar na sangs rgyas kyi ye shes de ni/ shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyir rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yin no/ /spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i ye shes yin pas shes rab dang*/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs mthar thug pa'i phyir/ pha rol tu phyin pa yin pas na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /dngos po gny-is pa lam thams cad shes pa nyid ni/ mdo las bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du lam gyi rnam pa 'tshol ba nyid byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lags/

rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ni nyan thos kyi lam gang yin pa dang*/ rang sangs rgyas kyi lam gang yin pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi lam gang yin pa'i lam thams cad bskyed par bya zhing*/ lam thams cad shes par bya'o/ /de dag kyang*/ yongs su rdzogs par bya zhing*/ de dag gi lam gyi bya ba yang bya la/ smon lam yongs su rdzogs par ma byas pa dang*/ sems can yongs su smin par ma byas pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su ma sbyangs par/ de dag gis yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon sum du ni mi bya'o/ /de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ni/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ces bya'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'di la phal che ba dag lam gsum skye med du rtogs pa dang*/ lam gsum rang bzhin med par rtogs pa zhes zer zhing*/ de'i skye med dang rang bzhin med pa ni/ sher phyin yin par ston pa'i mtshan nyid kyi zur du bsams pa'o/ /de ltar yang rung ba ni yin mod kyi/ sher phyin gyi mtshan nyid de 'dra kho nar bzung dgos pa yang ma yin no/ /de lta mod kyi/ dper na gzugs sogs phung po dmigs pa'i rten du bzhag nas/ de bden med du sgom pa'am/ snang cha de'i rnam pa bden med du shar ba lta bur/ 'dir yang dmigs yul theg pa gsum gyi lam gyi mtshan nyid blo la nges par byas nas/ de'i 'dra'i mtshan nyid kyi rnam pa yid yul du shar ba de la dmigs nas 'di rang bzhin med do snyam sgom pa'am/ sa lam so so'i mnyam gzhag rjes thob kyi nyams myong shar ba rnams sgyu ma ltar rang bzhin med pa'i don sgom pa tsam yang gnas skabs 'di'i lam skye med kyi go don min no/ /'o na ci zhe na/ lam gyi rnam pa skye med ces pa/ skye med rnam pa'i lam zhes pa'i don du 'gyur te/ rang rgyud kyi mnyam gzhag gam rjes thob kyi lam gang yin pa de yang*/ skye 'gag gnas gsum la sogs pa spros pa thams cad rang sar zhi ba'i rnam pa'am/

'ga' zhig dngos su spros pa'i rnam pa tsam snang du chug kyang*/ mnyam gzhag spros med kyi shugs kyis zin pas/ spros pa'i mtshan ma stobs bri nas spros med dang 'dra rung du gyur pa ni/ skye med rnam pa'i lam yin la/ de rtogs tshul lam/ shes tshul ni/ mnyam gzhag la rang rig kho na dang*/ rjes thob la gnyis ka'o/ /des na byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mnyam gzhag rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes/ chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa spros bral gyi rnam pa can de ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgrub par byed pa'i lam dngos yin cing*/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi rgyud kyi gang zag gi bdag med pa rtogs pa la sogs pa de dag nyid kyi/ 'khrul med kyi ye shes gang yin pa de dang*/ rtogs tshul gang yin pa dang*/ yon tan gang yin pa dang phan yon gang yin pa ji lta ba de 'dra re/ zhor byung gi yon tan du ma'i lhag dang bcas par/ de la tshang bas na theg pa gsum char gyi lam zhes bya zhing*/ de nyid rang rig pas shes pa'i phyir lam shes so/ /rdzogs smin sbyang gsum ma byas kyi bar du/ yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du mi byed pa'i las can dang*/ skabs gzhan du nyon mongs ched du mi spong ba'i las can du bshad pa sogs ni/ byang chub sems pa'i gnas skabs nyid kyi dbang du byas pa'i lam shes la khyad par de dag tshang ba yin kyang*/ lam shes su 'jog byed la de ltar dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /sangs rgyas ni 'bras bu mthar thug pa yin pas/ rnam mkhyen kyi skabs su rnam brtags mtshan ma gsum kar bshad pa yin la/ byang sems kyi 'bras bu mtha' dag mngon du ma byas pas lam tsam zhig kho na smos pa yin no/ /dngos po gsum pa gzhi shes ni/ mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du thams cad 'tshal ba nyid nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi lags/ rab 'byor thams cad ni phyi dang nang gi chos rnams ji snyed pa tsam yin la/ de dag kyang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyis shes kyi/

lam thams cad kyis kyang ma yin la/ rnam pa thams cad du yang ma yin pas/ de'i phyir nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi ni/ thams cad shes pa nyid ces bya'o zhes so/ /'dir gzhi phyi nang gi chos rnams shes pa zhes pa las shes tshul ji ltar yin mi gsal yang*/ nyan rang gi rtogs pa yin pa'i phyir na/ gang zag gi bdag med pa'i rtogs tshul yin dgos te/ mdo las/ phung po gang zag bdag med par/ /rab tu rnam phye mthong gyur cing*/ chos kyi dngos yod ma bshig pas/ /nyan thos de dag mngon rtogs 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de lta bas na/ nyan rang 'phags pa chos kyi bdag med mngon sum du ma rtogs te de'i phyir chos kyi bdag 'dzin spangs pa yang ma yin no/ /'on kyang gang zag gi bdag med nyid rtogs pa'i shugs kyis/ dngos por 'dzin yang cung zad srab par gyur pa ni yin la/ de dag gi mnyam gzhag na chos bdag gi snang ba ma log kyang*/ chos kyi bdag 'dzin mngon gyur pa yang med pas/ de 'dra'i mnyam gzhag de dag kyang chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i ye shes dang 'dzin stangs 'gal ba ma yin pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang cung zad rjes su mthun pa ni yin no/ /des na nyan rang 'phags pa'i ye shes de ni/ gzhi phyi nang gi chos phung khams skye mched thams cad la/ ji ltar rigs par mi rtag pa la sogs pa rnam pa'i shes pa bcu drug po de dag kun 'jug pa yin kyang*/ rnam pa'i gtso bo yin pa dang*/ spros bral dang cha shas mthun pa'i ldog pa nye bar bzung nas/ bdag med par ni shes la/ de shes pas nyan rang gi lam shes pa tsam du ni 'gyur yang spros pa dang bral bar ni ma shes pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rtogs tshul gyis ni/ lam de gnyis kyang ma shes la/ khyad par du lam gyi gtso bo theg chen gyi lam ni gtan nas kyang ma shes pa'i phyir/ nyan rang gi ye shais de lam shes par mi 'gyur zhing*/ ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa thams cad mi shes pas na/

rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid lta ga la zhig ste/ de'i phyir gzhi kho na shes pas gzhi shes zhes bya'o/ /'on kyang 'di ni nyan rang gi gzhi shes zhes bya zhing*/ mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes kyi nang du gtogs pa tsam yin la/ gnyen po'i gzhi shes ni/ mkhyen gsum gyis zlas phye ba'i gzhi shes dngos sam btags pa ba gang du bzhag na legs shes dpyod ldan rnams kyis rnam par dpyod cig dang*/ gzhi shes kyi skabs kyi mdo dang bstan bcos kyi/ gzhung dngos bstan gyi brjod bya'i

£¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ gtso bo £© gzhi shes ni gnyen po'i gzhi shes 'di kho na yin la/ gzhung gi dngos bstan ltar na/ mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes kyang nyan rang gi de gtso mi che ste/ gtso bor byang chub sems dpa' so so skye bo dmigs pa'i lta ba can rnams yin no/ /gnyen po gzhi shes de yang gang zhe na/ mnyam gzhag rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes spros pa thams cad spangs pa de la/ bdag dang byed po dang*/ rtag dngos dang*/ myong tshor bde ba sogs gang yang gdod nas ma dmigs par rtag pa'i cha gcig 'dug pa de nyid/ nyan rang gi lam shes pa'i lam shes yin la/ gnyen po gzhi shes kyang yin no/ /yang bdag tu 'dzin pa'i bag chags drung nas 'byin pa'i phyir/ gang zag gi bdag med pa ched gtad bsgoms pa na/ bdag ni rang bzhin gyis med par mthong zhing*/ lhag ma gzhan dngos po dang dngos po med pa'i spros pa rnams kyang zhor la rang bzhin med par rtogs nas/ spros pa dang mtshan ma thams cad zhig pa'i rnam pa can te/ spros bral rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi sdong po bdag med pa'i rtsa ba can de ni gnyen po'i gzhi shes nyid yin no/ /bdag 'dzin gyi bag chags drung nas 'byin pa la/ spyi khyab kyi spros bral de kho na rtogs pas chog gi /gang zag med pa la gtso bor dmigs pas/ ci zhig bya snyam na/ ma yin te dmigs pa rnams kyi nus pa ni tha dad pa yin pas/ stong nyid kho nas chags sdang la sogs pa yang bzlog pa yin mod kyang mi sdug pa'i ting nge 'dzin spros bral gyi rnam pa can gyis 'dod chags kyi bag chags lhag par bzlog pa dang*/ byams pa'i sems spros bral gyi rnam pa can gyis zhe sdang gi bag chags lhag par bzlog pa bzhin no/ /rigs pas kyang 'thad de/ mi sdug pa dang*/ byams pa dang*/ bdag med pa de dag kyang de dang de mngon gyur 'phral du bzlog pa'i nus pa can ni yin la/ spyi'i gnyen po stong nyid de yang ma tshang ba med par bsgoms pa'i phyir/

gcig pu kho na las gnyis kar 'dzom pa stobs che ba rmos ma dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /rang rgyal gyis bzung ba chos kyi bdag med mngon sum rtogs sam ma rtogs zhe na/ ma rtogs zhes bya'o/ /'o na ji skad du/ gzung don rtog pa spong phyir dang*/ /'dzin pa mi spong phyir dang ni/ /brten gyi bse ru lta bu'i lam/ /yang dag bsdus pa shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ma yin nam/ ce na/ rang rgyal rnams ni rten 'brel yun ring du goms pa las/ 'jig rten ma rig pa'i rkyen can du shes pas na/ de'i shugs kyis gzung ba'i rnam rtog shin tu nyams smad pa yin pas/ de lta bu'i rtogs pa de yang byang chub sems dpa'i lam shes kyi rtogs rigs kyi nang du 'dus te/ de yang byang chub sems dpa' skabs 'ga' zhig tu chos thams cad sems kyi snang ba tsam du rtogs pas/ nga bdag dang phyi rol kyi don gdod nas ma grub £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+par £© rtogs shing*/ de nyid kyang spros pa thams cad dang gdod nas bral ba'i rnam pa can yin mod kyi/ 'dzin pa la ched gtad shugs phyung nas stong par bsgom pa med pas/ gzung don gyi rtogs pa spong*/ 'dzin pa'i rtog pa mi spong zhes tha snyad mdzad pa yin gyi/ 'dzin pa'i mngon zhen dang bcas pa ni ma yin no/ /de lta bu'i ye shes des/ rang rgyal gyi rtogs pa gang yin pa de/ rigs mthun gyi tshul gyis bsdus pa yin pas rang rgyal gyi lam gyi ming gis btags pa tsam mo/ /de ltar bshad zin pa'i mkhyen pa gsum po de ni/ lam gyi bden pa'i dbang du byas la/ dngos po brgyad kyi skabs 'dir gtso bo yang lam bden 'di yin mod/ spyir chos nyid don dam pa'i ye shes bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po ni/ sher phyin mthar thug pa yang yin la/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang*/ lam shes pa nyid dang*/ gzhi thams cad shes pa nyid de/ 'di ni don dam 'gog pa'i bden pa yin cing*/ sher phyin gyi mdo dang gzhung gi sbas don mthar thug gi snying po yin par shes par bya'o/

/de ltar mkhyen pa gsum gyi ngo bo ni de 'dra yin la/ lam gyi bden pas bsdus pa'i mkhyen gsum gyi rtogs bya'am/ /gnas lugs chos kyi dbyings spros bral gyi rig pa de ni bdag med gnyis sam/ rnam pa skye med/ lam skye med gzhi skye med/ ces sogs tha snyad du mas bsnyad de/ thos bsam gyis gtan la 'bebs pa'i yul dang*/ sbyor ba rnams kyi bsgom bya dmigs pa'i yul yang yin no/ /dngos po bzhi pa rnam rdzogs sbyor ba ni/ gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu'i chos rnams/ rang bzhin gdod nas stong pa ny-id du mtshungs kyang*/ so so'i mtshan nyid rnam pa mi 'dra ba rnams ma 'dres shing ma 'dzengs par blos rtogs nas/ thams cad spros pa dang bral bas ro snyoms shing*/ sems dngos po gang la yang mi gnas par yid la mi byed pa'i tshul du bsgom mo/ /de la mi rtag pa lta bu'i gsal snang bsgrubs te spros bral du bsre nus pa nas/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba tsam rgyud la skye ba'i 'go brtsams pa yin la/ rnam pa gzhan thams cad kyang re re bzhin rim pas bsgrubs shing spros bral gyi ngor rim gyis skye la/ mthar shes pa skad cig gcig la rnam pa thams cad dus mnyam du shar bar gyur pa na/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba mthar phyin pa yin te tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i ye shes kyi bar du 'di yod par 'dod pa ltar 'thad la/ 'di la mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa bsdus sgom gyi sbyor ba zhes zer te/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa ni gong du smos pa ltar/ lam gyi bden pa'i dmigs yul rtogs bya chos dbyings de'i rnam pa yin cing*/ dngos gnas la rnam pa'i grangs tshad bzung bar mi nus kyang*/ don gyi gtso bo rnams bsdus pa'i phyir dang*/ gdul bya nye ba'i bsam pa la dgongs nas/ rnam pa brgya bdun bcu rtsa gsum zhes grags so/ /bsdus sgom gyi go don ni/ dper na 'dus byas mi rtag par yid la byas shing*/ de yang rang bzhin med pa la bslabs pas/

gsal snang thob pa na/ zag bcas sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa yid la byed cing*/ de rang bzhin med pa la gsal snang sgrub bo/ /de yang thob pa na/ mi rtag sdug bsngal gnyis ka dus gcig la yid la byed cing*/ rang bzhin med par gsal snang yang dus mnyam du sgrubs pas/ mnyam gzhag skad cig ma gcig po de la shes pa gcig po des/ 'dus byas kyi snang ba thams cad mi rtag pa'i rnam pa can du yang shes/ zag bcas kyi snang ba thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa can du yang shes/ gzhi 'dus byas dang zag bcas gnyis dang mtshan nyid mi rtag pa dang sdug bsngal rnams kyang snang ba tsam ma gtogs/ rang bzhin gyis stong par mthong ba na/ mi rtag pa dang sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa phyogs gcig tu bsdus te sgom pa yin pas/ bsdus bsgom zhes bya'o/ /mi rtag pa dang sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa ma 'gags pa dgos te/ de med na bsdus te sgom par mi 'gyur zhing*/ rnam pa'i rnam grangs mang po bshad pa rnams kyang don med du 'gyur bas so/ /snang cha de'i steng du spros pa dang bral bar 'jog ma shes na yang*/ mi rtag sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa tsam gyis sher phyin sgom par mi 'gyur zhing*/ gnas lugs la reg par mi 'gyur bas/ spyi dang khyad par gyi rnam pa thams cad sgom dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan de ltar yin no/ /'dir sbyor ba zhes pa ni nyams len sgom pa'i rnal 'byor yin te/ de ltar na 'di dag ni gzhan rnams la yang rigs 'gre'o/ /dngos po lnga pa rtse mo'i sbyor ba ni/ bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa zhes bya ste/ rab tu gyur pa'i go don shin tu byang ba dang gong 'phel du gyur pa ste/ de la rnam rdzogs ni/ rnam pa gnyis kyi bsdus sgom nas rnam pa thams cad kyi bar du/ bsdus sgom ma thob pa thob par byed pa dang*/ thob pa mi nyams par byed pa yin cing*/ rtse sbyor 'di ni/ rnam pa gnyis nas rnam pa thams cad pa'i bar du so sor sbyar te/

bsdus sgom de dang de thob cing ma nyams par sngar nas byas pa de/ shin tu byang bas shugs 'byung la 'jug pa'i phyir dang*/ skabs de dang de'i yon tan rnams sgrub pa'i phyir dang*/ mi rtag pa lta bu gcig la yang rtogs tshul mi 'dra ba du ma'i sgo nas/ shes rab kyi snang ba spel ba'i phyir sgom pa yin no/ /de ltar bsgoms pas gnas skabs de dang de dag tu de 'dra mngon du gyur pa na rtse mo'i sbyor ba thob pa zhes bya ste/ sbyor lam drod nas rgyun mtha'i ye shes kyi bar du yod do/ /dngos po drug pa mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba ni/ bsdus sgom de nyid ma nyams bzhin du rim pa mi 'dra ba sna tshogs la bslabs pas/ 'phel ba'i rgyun de nyid byang zhing shin tu brtan par byed pa ste/ dper na sngar gyi bsdus sgaum de nyid/ chu tshod cig tu sgom par byed na/ chu srang bzh-i lhag tsam zhig sems spros bral gyi snang cha mi rtag sdug bsngal sogs su cig car shar ba de/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can la snying rjes sbyin pa gtong ba'i sems pas mgo bsdus te sgrom pa dang*/ de rjes rgyun de tsam zhig /tshul khrims spong sems kyis mgo bsdus te sgom pa sogs/ phar phyin drug dang*/ rjes dran drug dang*/ dngos med ngo bo nyid de bcu gsum la sbyar ro/ /de la goms nas dbugs bcu gsum gyi ring la chos bcu gsum sbyar te sgom pa lta bu dang*/ : rig ¡¶dzaṃ¡· rim £© pas dus mtha'i skad cig ma bcu gsum la sbyar ba lta bu dang*/ mthar mtha' med pa'i bar du sbyar te/ 'di ni sbyor ba snga ma gnyis kyi rtsa sbyong ba yin la sbyor ba snga ma gnyis ni rnam pa mi 'dra ba du ma gcig tu bsdus te sgom pa yin la/ 'di ni bsdus zin de 'dra yongs rdzogs re re bzhin/ skad cig re rer rnam pa mi 'dra ba du mar 'char ba la slob pa yin pas/ rnam pa so sor phye ste sgom pa yin no/ /'o na phye ba'i phyir rnam pa nyung ngu song ba yin nam snyam na min te/

snga ma rnams las kyang ches mang bar 'gyur ro/ /dper na shes pa gcig la rnam pa bcu drug dus mnyam du 'char ba bsgrubs zin pa de/ slar yang rnam pa bcu drug po so so ma nyams bzhin du/ thams cad mi rtag pa'i rnam pa gcig tu 'char ba dang*/ thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa gcig tu 'char ba dang*/ thams cad stong pa gcig tu 'char ba la sogs skad cig re re bzhin du 'phos shing sgom pa yin te/ sngar gyi rnam pa mang po de dag kyang re re bzhin rnam pa gnyis sbrag tu bslabs par 'gyur la/ sngar rnam pa mang po de dag stong nyid tsam gyis khyab byed du byed pa las gzhan med na yang*/ 'dir rnam pa thams cad la mi rtag pa'i rnam pas khyab pa dang*/ rnam pa thams cad la sdug bsngal gyi rnam pas khyab pa sogs/ rnam pa thams cad la re re bzhin rnam pa thams cad kyis khyab par bsgrubs pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang skabs 'dir/ bsdus sgom gyi rnam pa rnams sngar dus mnyam du grub zin pa'i rgyun de ka yin kyang rgyas 'debs byed rnams dus mnyam du ma grub pas/ snga phyi phraing chags su byed dgos pa'i phyir/ mthar gyis rim gyis sgrub pa zhes bya ste/ chos gcig bsgoms pas chos thams cad bsgom pa dang*/ skad cig gcig la yang ting nge 'dzin du ma la ldang 'jug nus par 'gyur ba'i rgyu bla na med pa ste/ 'di'i sa mtshams la 'dod tshul mi 'dra ba mang yang*/ sbyor lam nas rgyun mtha'i snga logs kyi bar du yod do zhes gsungs pa ltar na/ bdag gi rnam par rtog pa ni sbyor lam yang bzod pa la bya dgos par sems so/ /'dir chos bcu gsum bshad pa ni mtshon pa tsam ste/ chos kyi rnam pa mtha' yas pa mtha' dag go /de ltar na sbyor ba gsum po de dang*/ snga ma snga ma la brten nas phyi ma phyi ma skye zhing*/ phan tshun spel ba'i tshul du rgyud la skye ba yin te/ dper na rnam pa nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i bsdus sgom thob pa na/

rnam pa nyer bdun po de rnams nyid kyi rtse mo'i sbyor bas byang zhing 'phel ba la slob par byed do/ /de nas nyer bdun po de rnams re re bzhin nyer bdun po de dag thams cad du 'char ba'i phyir/ nyer bdun po la rnam pa re re bzhin gyis rgyas 'debs pa'i mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba sgom dgos te/ des rnam pa mang nyung thams cad la rigs 'gre'o/ /'on kyang sbyor ba gsum po de thog mar thob pa'i sa mtshams ni mi 'dra ste/ bsdus sgaum ni tshogs lam na yang yod cing bsdus sgom la byang zhing 'phel ba ni/ de na med pa'i phyir/ tshogs lam na rnam rdzogs yod kyi rtse mo med do/ /byang zhing 'phel ba sbyor lam drod rtse gnyis nas yod kyang*/ rnam pa mang pos rnam pa mang po la rgyas thebs pa de na med pas/ rtse sbyor yod kyang mthar gyis pa med do/ /bzod pa nas ni rgyas thebs tshul de yod pa'i phyir mthar gyis pa yang yod de/ de nas brtsams te gsum ka spel mar 'byung ngo*/ /rtse sbyor ma thob pa'i sngon du mthar gyis pa yod par 'dod pa mi 'thad de/ de ni rtse sbyor gyi bsdus sgom 'phel ba'i rgyun de nyid la/ rim sgom du byed pa nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ kha cig sa bdun pa man chad mkhyen gsum gyi mngon rtogs dang*/ brgyad pa yan chad la sbyor bzhi'i mngon rtogs yod par 'dod cing*/ de las kyang kha cig de dag re re la yang sbyor mthong sgom gsum gyi dbye ba sogs byed pa ni 'thad par ma mthong la bka' gdams pa 'ga' zhig na re/ 'phags seng gis mngon rtogs kyi don rnams lam mthon po kho na yang yang sbyor ba ni/ rang re da lta'i gang zag rnams la sku drin chung ste/ 'di thams cad la da lta nyid nas nyams su blang rgyu dgos gsung ba yang*/ rjes mthun gyi dbang du byas na bden pas/ las dang po pa nyid nas dngos po brgyad kar gyi rgyu tshogs la bslab du yod do/ /gzhan sbyor ba dang mngon rtogs kyi dbye ba ltar na/

rnam rdzogs sogs sbyor ba gsum po 'di la/ so skye'i gnas skabs na ni sbyor ba tsam yin la/ 'phags pa'i lam gyi de dang de ni mngon rtogs kyang yin no/ /dngos po bdun pa skad cig ma'i sbyor ba ni/ spros pa dang bral ba/ rab tu zhi ba/ rab tu dben pa'i ye shes skad cig ma gcig gis ji ltar ji snyed gyi chos thams cad kyang cig car shes la/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis 'di ni lam gyis bsdus pa'i ye shes dang yon tan dang dge ba'i chos thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur cing*/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sas bsdus pa'i chos rnams kyi snang cha thams cad gzugs brnyan gyi tshul du shar bas ni/ chos thams cad skad cig gcig gis rtogs nus pa'i phyir dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi byang chub de ma thag tu thob nus pa'i phyir/ skad cig gcig gis mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa zhes bya'o/ /mngon rtogs 'di ni rgyun mtha'i skabs kho na yin kyang*/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas la dbang sgyur ba yin pas na/ skad cig la bskal par ston pa sogs 'byung ba'i phyir/ dus yun ring thung 'di tsam zhes bsam par mi nus so/ /mthar gyis pa'i skabs su/ phan tshun yang yang rgyas btab pa'i nus pa rnams 'dir shin tu smin pas/ dge chos gcig la dmigs pas dge chos gzhan ma lus pa yang cig char 'byung ba yin pas na/ mthar gyis pa yongs su gyur nas/ skad cig mar song ba yin te/ skabs 'dir rtag pa mthar bzung ste mthar chags su bsgom pa zhig gal te srid du chug kyang*/ mthar chags su mi yong bar kun dus su 'byung ba yin no/ /de yang shin tu dbang 'byor bas gal te 'dod na ni/ mthar chags su 'byung ba yang srid mod kyi/ skad cig ma grub nas mthar chags bsgoms pa la dgos pa med pa'i phyir 'dod par mi byed do/ /de la mthar chags rkyang par bsgoms pa'i nus pa yongs su rdzogs pa ni/ mthar gyis pa'i mngon rtogs legs par thob zin pa yin la/

de nas rgyas 'debs nyis sbrag tu byed de/ rnam pa thams cad la sbyin pa dang tshul khrims gnyis kyis rgyas 'debs pa/ snga phyi rim can ma yin par dus mnyam du byed do/ /de ltar nyis sbrag dus mnyam du rgyas thebs pa nas brtsams te/ rnam pa thams cad du rgyas 'debs mtha' med pa'i bar du sbyor ba ni/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba tsam yin te/ 'di ni rgyun mtha' sngon rol nas yod cing*/ skad cig ma'i mngon rtogs ni ma yin no/ /rgyas 'debs de yang lhun grub kyi tshul gyis 'byung dgos te/ 'bad rtsol can yin na ni skad cig ma'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyur mi 'gyur bas/ mi g.yo ba'i sa yan chad la ci rigs pa yod par shes par bya'o/ /dngos po brgyd pa chos sku ni/ ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i chos sam shes bya thams cad kyi rang gzugs sam gnas lugs sam/ sdod lugs yin pa'i phy-ir/ chos kun gyi lus sam sku'o/ /yang stobs dang mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa/ yon tan dang dge chos ma lus pa thams cad/ gcig tu 'dus pa'i spyi gzugs yin pa'i phyir yang chos kyi sku zhes bya'o/ /de yang don ni sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad mnyam pa nyid ye shes kyi rgya mtsho chen po de yin te/ de yang dag pa gnyis ldan no/ /dag pa gnyis ldan dang*/ rang bzhin gyis dag pa gcig pu pa zhes pa yang*/ ngo bo so sor med cing mtshan gzhi'i ngos 'dzin yang tha dad du ma grub ste/ ye shes kyi rgya mtsho lta bu'i chos dbyings de nyid las/ gzhan ngos bzung du med pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang rnam gzhag gnyis po de ni/ rten gyi rgyud rigs mi 'dra ba gnyis la/ chos dbyings de de dang der song tshul tha dad pa yin te/ chos sku de la rang gi ngo bos ni glo bur gyi dri ma yang med mod kyi/ sems can rnams nyid glo bur gyi dri mas bsgribs pa'i phyir/ chos dbyings de sems can rnams la rang bzhin rnam dag kho nar song*/

sangs rgyas rnams ni rang rgyud la glo bur gyi dri ma dag pa'i phyir/ chos sku de yang sangs rgyas la ni dag pa gnyis ldan du song bas na/ sangs rgyas kyis chos dbyings dag pa gnyis ldan thob ces bya ba de yang*/ chos dbyings la dag pa gnyis ldan yin min gyi cha gnyis yod pa zhig las/ yin pa'i phyogs de thob pa'i don ma yin gyi/ sangs rgyas kyi rgyud kyis chos dbyings yongs rdzogs de dag pa gnyis ldan gyi tshul gyis thob pa la/ dag pa gnyis ldan thob ces bsgrags pa yin no/ /dper na khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin ni/ slong ba po rnams la zas gos kho na'i sbyin bdag yin gyi/ sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas pa'i ni yod byad thams cad kyi sbyin bdag yin no zhes brjod na/ khyim bdag gnyis ni med la/ zas gos kho na'i sbyin bdag dang yod byad thams cad kyi sbyin bdag mtshan nyid spyi ldog 'gal yang*/ sbyin yul so so la bltos nas mi 'gal ba bzhin no/ /chos sku 'di dang*/ gong gi mkhyen gsum 'gog bden ngo bo gcig cing*/ rnam mkhyen lam bden yang 'di'i khongs su bsdu ba yin mod kyi/ mkhyen gsum gyi skabs de dag tu ni/ da lta ma thob pa thob bya'i yul du bya ba dang*/ dmigs pa'i yul du byas nas bshad la/ 'dir ni 'bras bu de mngon du byed pa'i dbang du byas nas bshad pas/ don gyi 'chad tshul la ngo bo bzlos par mi 'gyur ro/ /de yang mngon rtogs brgyad sgrig pa'i dbang du byas na bzlos spong dgos la/ gzhan du na mdo'i dngos bstan dang rgyas bshad la bzlos pa'i dogs pa yang med do/ /de ltar na dngos po brgyad kyi ngos 'dzin gsal 'dus su bshad zin to/ /cung zad rgyas par bshad pa la/ sher phyin 'bum pa la sogs pa mdo rgyas pa rnams kyi dbang du mdzad nas/ don gyi gtso bo bdun bcu dang shin tu rgyas bshad la yan lag gi rnam grangs mtha' yas pa yod kyang*/ mdo 'dir ni rnam mkhyen mtshon byed kyi chos bdun dang lam shes dang*/

gzhi shes kyi ngo bo tsam dang*/ rnam kun gyi rnam pa dang*/ sbyor ba dang*/ rtse mor phyin pa'i spang bya spong ba'i gnyen po'i tshul tsam dang*/ mthar gyis pa'i ngo bo dang*/ skad cig ma'i ngo bo dang*/ chos sku'i don tshan bzhi po rnams te/ don gyi rnam grangs bco brgyad dam/ rtse sbyor gyi mthong sgom gnyis ka'i yang ngo bo cung zad gsal bas/ bcu dgur byas kyang rung ngo*/ /de la rnam mkhyen mtshon byed kyi chos zhes pa'i go don 'bras bu rnam mkhyen de thob byed kyi rgyu lam gyi rim pa yin pa'i don yin gyi/ rnam mkhyen gyi rtogs bya'i yul bcu yin par 'chad pa mi legs la/ sems bskyed la sogs pa 'di dag la/ rnam mkhyen gyi sgra sbyor ba ni de bas kyang shin tu mi 'thad de/ rnam mkhyen gyi sgra bshad rgyu tsam yod du chug kyang*/ nyan thos kyi theg pa dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang*/ sngags kyi theg pa rnams las/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kho na la gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnas skabs thams cad du shin tu grags pa dang ha cang 'gal ches pas so/ /dper na sangs rgyas la lha tshe ring po'i sgra bshad du yod kyang*/ de ltar tha snyad sbyar na shin tu mi mdzes pa bzhin no/ /mtshon byed kyi chos de dag kyang ji skad du/ sems bskyed pa dang gdams ngag dang*/ /nges 'byed yan lag rnam bzhi dang*/ /sgrub pa yi ni rten gyur pa/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin dang*/ /dmigs pa dag dang ched dang ni/ /go cha 'jug pa'i bya ba dang*/ /tshogs ni nges par 'byung bcus rnams/ /thub pa'i rnam kun mkhyen pa nyid/ /ces gsungs na/ sems bskyed ni/ gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod pa la ngos 'dzin pa ni spyir btangs tsam yin la/ de tsam zhig ni smon pa sems bskyed tsam yang yin no/ /de yang spyod pa pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang 'brel na ni/ 'jug pa sems bskyed zhes bya ste/

gang 'jug pa yod pa de la smon sems kyang yod do/ /sems bskyed tsam ni de ltar yin kyang*/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgrub pa sems bskyed du 'gyur ba la/ spros bral gyi lta ba sngon du song ba dgos shing de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can la stong nyid la brten nas snying rje 'jug des kun nas bslangs te sems bskyed pa yin pas/ dngos gzhi'i dus su yang dngos sam rjas mthun ci 'dra yang 'khor gsum rnam par mi rtog pa'i stong nyid kyis zin pa zhig dgos pa yin no/ /de'i tshe sems bskyed dang sems bskyed kyi spyod pa thams cad kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam du 'gyur ro/ /de yang las dang po pa nas/ sangs rgyas ma thob gyi bar du sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa yin la/ sangs rgyas kyi sar ni de'i rigs rgyun dmigs pa med pa'i/ snying rjes chen po ni yod kyang*/ sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid ni log pa yin cing*/ tshogs sbyor gyi lam du ni sems bskyed de yang sher phyin gyi sgrub pa kho na yin gyi sher phyin dngos ma yin la/ mthong lam thob nas ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sems bskyed dngos yin par shes par bya'o/ /gdams ngag ni/ slob dpon byang chub sems dpa' zhig gis/ slob ma byang chub tu sems bskyed pa gang la/ shes rab kyi pha rol phyin pa'i chos bstan pa'i ngag tshig gis rkyen byas te/ de'i rgyud la sher phyin gyi dbang du byas pa'i/ mnyam gzhag gi lam dngos rgyud la skyes pa'am/ sngar skyes la bogs phyin pa'am/ nyes skyon gyi gegs sel bar gyur pa'i gnas skabs de ni 'dir bstan gdams ngag gi lam zhes bya'o/ /gdams ngag khyad par can ni chos rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin thob nas/ de bzhin gshegs pas mngon sum du 'doms pa la bya ste/ gdams ngag ces bya ba dngos bstan ltar na/ 'doms pa'i ngag tshig la zer yang*/

'bras bu la rgyu'i ming gis btags nas/ de'i dngos kyi grub 'bras slob ma'i rgyud la skyes pa la bya'o/ /nges 'byed yan lag ni/ skabs 'dir theg chen sbyor lam ste/ nges pa ni chos nyid dang de 'byed pa ni mthong lam yin pas/ de'i yan lag ste rgyu tshogs ni de yin pa'i phyir ro/ /sbyor lam de chos nyid la gsal snang ni thob pa yin cing*/ mi rtog pa'i tshul gyis chos nyid cung zad rang gis rig pa yang yin la/ rnal 'byor pa'i mngon sum gyis rtogs pa ni ma yin pa dang*/ gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog glo bur pa rnams rim gyis 'gag par 'gyur ba yin pa dang*/ gang mngon 'gyur ba ma 'gags pa'i rtog pa de dang de yang*/ mnyam gzhag tu mi 'byung mod kyi/ rjes thob tu de dag 'byung zhing*/ de dag ma spangs pa'i stobs kyis mnyam gzhag kyang cung zad mi gsal ba yin no/ /sbyor lam gyi ye shes 'di kun yang mi rtog pa spros bral gyi rnam pa can yin pas/ bar bar na rnam par rtog pa'i 'dzin pa cung zad 'dres pa yod kyang rang gi ngo bo rtog pa nam yang ma yin cing*/ chos nyid cung zad tsam gsal la cung zad tsam mi gsal ba ni/ dper na seng ras kyis gdong g.yogs te dngos po la bltas pa bzhin no/ /de ltar sems bskyed cing gdams ngag mnos nas pha rol tu phyin pa'i don bsgoms

£¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ pa £© las/ nges 'byed yan lag rgyud la skyes te/ tshogs sbyor gyi lam chod par 'gyur bas rim pa de bzhin du bstan la/ spyir sems bskyed nyid dam gdams ngag nyid kyi nang du lam thams cad 'du ba yin pas go rim med kyang*/ go rim 'di dang por sems bskyed pa dang*/ dang por gdams ngag mnos pa'i dbang du byas pa yin no/ /de ltar na tshogs sbyor ni/ spyir rnam mkhyen gyi sgrub pa tsam yin kyang*/ khyad par can ni ma yin la/ sgrub pa khyad par can rnams ni 'phags pa'i lam yin pas/ lam de gtso bor bzhag pa'i dbang du byas nas/ ji ltar sgrub pa nyams su len pa thams cad kyi rten nam rgyu ni chos dbyings yin la/ chos dbyings de yang spros pa dang bral zhing rnam pa thams cad pa'o/ /de ni rang gi ngo bo'i staing nas kun rdzob kyi chos gang gis kyang ma gos mod/ rnal 'byor can gyi blo la 'char tshul gyi dbang du byas nas/ tshogs lam gyi rten chos dbyings dang*/ sbyor lam gyi rten chos dbyings sogs lam lnga dang sa bcu'i rten gyi 'jug tshul byed do/ /chos dbyings de nyer len gyi rgyu dgos min kyang*/ /'dra ba'i sgo nas sgrub pa'i nyer len gyi tha snyad 'jog go /chos dbyings de rang bzhin gnas rigs yin la/ thar pa'i rgyu dge chos 'phel ba'i rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs kyang de la brten te zhugs pa'i phyir/ de dang 'brel pa can yin pa'i rnam gzhag kyang byas so/ /sgrub pa'i dmigs pa tsam ni chos thams cad yin la/ dmigs pa'i gtso bo ni chos thams cad kyi chos nyid de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po yin pas/ don dam pa'i stong nyid de rten dang dmigs pa gnyis kar du rung ngo*/ /ched du bya ba ni sgrub pa byed pa'i skabs kyi 'dod don te/ 'di la rgya bod phal cher sangs rgyas kyi sas bsdus pa'i spangs rtogs 'phrin las gsum mam sku bzhi'am/ mkhyen gsum sogs chen po gsum dang sbyor ba zhig snang yang*/

de'i thad kyi mdo dang mi mthun la/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sgra bshad sangs rgyas la sbyor ba yang*/ 'tsham pa las 'das pa'i bshad pa yin pas/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' nyid kyi spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe/ 'phral 'phral du dgos pa'i 'dod don yin gyi/ mthar thug gi ched du bya ba kho na ma yin no/ /mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa'i sgra bshad kyi dbang du mdzad nas/ sems dpa' dang sems dpa' chen po'i sgra bshad kyis sems chen po dang*/ byang ba'i sgra bshad kyis spong ba chen po dang*/ chub pa'i sgra bshad kyis rtogs pa chen po bstan te/ mdo rgyas pa na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis sems chen po dang*/ shā ri'i bus spong ba chen po dang*/ rab 'byor gyis rtogs pa chen po rnams gsungs la/ yon tan rin po che bsdud pa las/ ci phyir de ni sems dpa' che zhes bya zhe na/ /sems can tshogs rnams mang po'i mchog tu gyur pa dang*/ sems can khams kyi lta rnams chen po gcod pa ste/ /de phyir 'di ni sems dpa' che zhes rab brjod de/ /gtong ba che dang blo che ba dang mthu che dang*/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi theg chen mchog la zhugs pa dang*/ /go cha chen po bsgos shing bdud kyi rgyu 'dul ba/ /de yi phyir na sems dpa' che zhes brjod pa yin/ /ces gsungs te/ 'jig rten pa rnams dang*/ nyan thos dang rang rgyal dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi/ yon tan gyi tshogs rnams las ji ltar 'os 'os su skad cig re re bzhin ma thob pa rnams thob par byed/ thob pa rnams spel bar byed pa'i 'jug pa sems bskyed dang ldan pas sems can gzhan thams cad kyi gtso bo dang mchog tu gyur pa ni sems chen po'o/ /bdag nyid kyis gzhan la chos bstan pas/ de rnams kyi bdag lta dang mthar lta la sogs pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ lam dang 'bras bu la 'dzin pa'i dmigs pa'i lta ba thams cad kyang spong bar byed pa ni spong ba chen po dang*/

sbyin pa chen po la sogs pa gzhan la med pa'i khyad chos dpag tu med pa mnga' ba rnams la yang*/ chos dbyings kyi rang bzhin rtogs pa'i stobs kyis ma chags pa ni rtogs pa chen po ste/ ri rab la mngon par dmigs na n+ya gro dha'i sdong po la che ba'i blo mi skye ba bzhin no/ /'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod pa gang spyod kyang*/ 'phral 'phral du ched gtad sbyor dgos pas/ ched du bya ba zhes bya ste/ 'phral 'phral du byed dgos rgyu'i don no/ /sgrub pa dngos ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug kar sher phyin gyis zin par byas nas lag len du 'debs pa yin te/ kha cig ngo bo phyin drug yin kyang sgrub pa'i ldog cha nas/ brtson 'grus yin pas/ sgrub pa'i ngo bo ni brtson 'grus so zhes phal cher zer na/ de tsam zhig don la zhugs su ni rung yang*/ bshad pa'i nus pa bzang po ni min no/ /shes rab snying po'i mdo 'dir sgrub pa bzhi'i dbye ba ma gsungs pas skabs 'dir mi 'chad la/ mdor na bdag nyid kyi yon tan rdzogs par byed pa'i sgrub pa dang*/ gzhan smin cing grol bar byed pa'i sgrub pa gnyis su ma 'dus pa med de/ rgyas par byang chub sems dpa'i sa las rtogs par bya'o/ /da ni lam shes pa nyid la mthong lam dang sgom lam gnyis su dbyer yod kyang*/ dmigs rnams kyi sgo nas mi 'dra ba med de/ mthong lam gyis ji ltar mthong ba'i don de nyid sgom lam gyis goms par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /sgom lam lam shes de yang ji lta bu snyam na/ ji skad du/ de yi ngo bo nyid mchog nyid/ /kun la mngon par 'du mi byed/ /chos rnams dmigs su med par ni/ /gtod bar byed pa don chen nyid/ /ces gsungs te/ mdo las kyang*/ sher phyin ni shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du snang bar bgyid pa'o/ /zhes sogs dang*/ sgrub pa med pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgrub par

bya'o/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ mun pa lta bu'i gzung 'dzin gyi snang ba sangs shing*/ ye shes kyi snang ba rgyas pa'i chos dbyings rnam pa kun ldan la mnyam par 'jog pa ni/ sgom lam mnyam gzhag de'i ngo bo nyid yin la/ de ni dge chos rnams thams cad kyi mchog yin cing*/ gzugs sogs kun rdzob kun la sgrub pa mngon par 'du mi byed cing thob par yang mi byed la/ chos de rnams dmigs pa med pa'i dbyings su gtad pas/ don dam gyi dbyings der thim par byed pa'i khyad chos dang ldan pa ste/ 'di ni mnyam gzhag sgrub pa sgom lam zhes bya zhing*/ rjes thob tu mos pa dang*/ bsngo ba dang rjes su yi rang gsum la slob dgos pa de ni mtshon byed de/ thabs mkhas kyi sgo thams cad la yang bslab par bya'o/ /rnam dag sgom lam zhes bya ba ni/ nyer lnga pa'i mdo 'dir dngos su med kyang 'phro don tsam du zhor la 'phangs pa'ang yin te/ sgom lam gyis thob pa'i rnam dag gi ming ngo*/ /de yang ji skad du/ 'bras bu dag pa gzugs la sogs/ dag pa nyid de gang gi phyir/ /de gnyis tha dad ma yin cing*/ /dpyad du med pas dag par brjod/ /ces gsungs te 'bras bu'i dag pa dang*/ rang bzhin gyi dag pa dbye ba med pa de nyid/ ji ltar rigs pa thob pa'i don no/ /de lta bu'i mthong lam dang sgom lam gyi ye shes rgyud la skyes pa na/ mdo rgyas pa las 'byung ba ltar phan yon sna tshogs pa rnams kyang 'byung ba yin no/ /gzhi shes kyi rang bzhin ni gong du bshad zin la/ nyan rang gi rgyud kyi gzhi shes sam byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud kyi yang*/ thabs mkhas dang mi ldan pa de ni/ chos kyi dbyings la thag ring pa yin cing*/ thabs mkhas dang ldan pa ni nye ba'o/ /'on kyang byang sems 'phags pa ni thabs la mi mkhas pa mi srid cing*/ so so skye bo'i de ni gzhi shes min pas/ theg chen pa la chos dbyings la thag ring pa'i gzhi shes med do snyam na/

gzhi shes kyi sgrub pa la gzhi shes su btags pa yin pas/ so so skye bo la yod do/ /mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes zer ba ni/ theg pa chen po rtogs pa 'gyur ba la mi mthun phyogs kyi khyad par zhig gi ming ste/ nyan rang gi gzhi shes kyang de'i nang tshan yin mod kyi/ gtso bor byang chub sems dpa' rnams nyid/ gang zag gi bdag med pa sgom pa'i tshe/ dngos por 'dzin pa dang stong par 'dzin pa skye na de'i ming yin te/ ji skad du/ gzugs sogs phung po stong nyid dang*/ /dus gsum rtogs pa'i chos rnams dang*/ /sbyin sogs byang chub phyogs rnams la/ /spyod pa'i 'du shes mi mthun phyogs/ /zhes so/ /gnyen po'i gzhi shes ni/ byang chub sems dpa' gang zag gi bdag med pa sgom pa'i tshe yang*/ sangs rgyas la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i yid byed dam chags pa phra mos kyang ma gos par byed dgos na/ gzhan la 'dzin cing chags pa 'gog pa lta smos kyang ci dgos pas/ gang zag gi bdag med sgom pa de yang*/ sems can nam phung po'i rnam pa ma log pa de 'dra ma yin par/ spros pa thams cad dang bral ba rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i rnam pa can no/ /de'i phyir bdag med des zin pa'i spyod pa yang 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa la rang gnas shing gzhan yang 'god pa'o/ /de ltar yang*/ sbyin la sogs pa ngar 'dzin med/ /gzhan dag de la 'jug pa dang*/ /de ni chags pa'i mtha' 'gog pas/ /rgyal la sogs la chags pa phra/ /chos kyi lam ni rang bzhin gyis/ /dben pa'i phyir na de zab nyid/ /chos rnams rang bzhin gcig par ni/ /shes pas chags pa spong ba yin/ /ces gsungs te/ rang bzhin gcig pa ni rang bzhin 'od gsal bar gcig pas de shes pa'o/ /rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i rnam pa zhes bya ba ni/ chos nyid don dam pa rnam pa thams cad par gnas pa las/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rnam par 'gro rgyu rnams ni/ yul gyi rnam pa ste/ deng sang don rnam zhes grags pa dmigs yul yin pas/

rnam kun dngos ma yin la/ dmigs yul de rnams la bsgoms pas/ me long la gzugs brnyan shar pa ltar rang gi shes pa yang*/ rnam pa de dag dag mtshungs par shar ba ni/ yul can gyi rnam pa ste/ deng sang shes rnam du grags pa yin pas/ de ni rnam rdzogs nyid dang ngo bo gcig go /de la bstan bcos dang mdo rgyas pa las/ gzhi shes la bden bzhi'i rnam pa nyer bdun dang*/ lam shes la bden bzhi'i rnam pa so drug dang*/ rnam mkhyen la sna tshogs pa'i rnam pa brgyad dang bcu bshad pa las/ mkhyen pa dang po gnyis kyi rnam pa rnams bden bzhi'i rnam par 'dus so/ /de yang bden pa bzhi la dmigs nas kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam gyi rgyu 'bras rten 'brel 'gag pa med kyang*/ rang bzhin spros pa thams cad dang bral bas khyad par du byas pa nyid las nga bdag ma dmigs pa ni/ gzhi shes kyi rnam pa dang*/ bden bzhis bsdus pa'i kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad rten 'brel sgyu ma lta bu la/ don dam par ci yang ma yin pa nam mkha' lta bu ste spros bral dang*/ rang gi nyams su star ba'i dge chos thams cad kyang*/ spros pa dang bral ba'i rang bzhin nyid du gnas pa ni/ lam shes kyi rnam pa dang*/ don dam pa'i dbyings de ni nam mkha' ltar spros pa thams cad dang bral zhing*/ spros bral de nyid rnam pa thams cad par gdod nas shar ba dang*/ khyad par du yang byang phyogs dang phar phy-in dang stobs bcu sogs dge chos thams cad kyi rnam par gnas pa ni rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa yin no/ /rnam pa de lta bu tshang bar byas nas ji ltar sgom pa'i tshul ni/ sbyor ba ste de yang mi gnas pa'i sbyor ba zhes bya la/ dngos po dang mtshan ma dang dmigs pa gang la yang mi gnas pa'i phyir ro/ /des na chos gang dag skyes pa dang*/ byung ba dang*/ 'byung ba dang*/ gnas pa dang*/ 'phel ba dang yod pa sogs su mi 'dzin cing*/ de dag la sems mi gnas la/ 'gags pa dang*/ mi 'byung ba dang*/

ma byung ba dang*/ ma phrad pa dang*/ ma tshogags pa dang*/ 'gribs pa dang*/ med pa sogs la yang sems mi gnas te/ gang la yang mi gnas/ gar yang mi 'gro/ ci la yang mi 'gog gang du yang mi 'gyur ba'i tshul gyis mnyam par 'jog pa nyid yin te/ rtsol ba med pa'i phyir khyad chos mi sbyor ba'i sbyor ba sogs kyang de la tshang ba yin pas/ sbyor ba ni nyi shu'am lnga la sogs par grags kyang gcig kho na yin no/ /de ltar yang gzugs la sogs la mi gnas phyir/ de la sbyor ba bkag pa'i phyir/ zhes so/ /mdo 'di las dngos su mi gnas pa'i sbyor ba kho na bstan to/ /rtse mo'i sbyor ba dngos ni/ mthong sgom bar chad med rtse gsum po yin na/ de rnams kyang shais rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rnam pa kho nar gcig pas/ dmigs rnam mi 'dra ba'i tshul du med mod/ 'on kyang*/ spang bya spong tshul dang yon tan mngon par sgrub pa'i khyad par ni shin tu che la/ de la spang bya gzung 'dzin gyi rtogs pa bzhi ni/ gzung bya'i snang ba la brtain nas kun nas nyon mongs kyi rnam rtog skye ba 'dod chags zhe sdang la sogs pa dang*/ de dag gi gnas ngan len la brtain pa'i rnam rtog ni gzhi kun nas nyon mongs kyi rnam rtog gam gzung rtog ste dang po'o/ /gzung ba'i snang ba la brten nas skyes pa'i dad pa la sogs pa dge chos kyi rnam par rtog pa dngos por mngon par zhen pa'i mtshan nyid du 'dug pa de ni/ gnyen po gzung rtog ces bya ba yin no/ /phyi rol gzung ba'i snang ba la mngos su ma dmigs kyang*/ sems kyi rgyud tsam la dmigs nas/ bdag gam chos rdzas yod du 'dzin pa ni/ rdzas 'dzin rtog pa zhes bya la/ sems kyi rgyud la dmigs nas/ gang zag gam chos btags yod tsam du 'dzin pa ni/ btags 'dzin rtog pa zhes bya'o/ /rnam rtog de dag las mngon 'gyur ba ni sbyor lam bzhis rim gyis spong ba yin la/ de rnams kyi nang nas chos nyid kyi ngo bo tsam mthong ba la sgrib pa mthong bas spang bar bya ba gang yin pa de dag ni mthong lam rtse sbyor gyis sa bon drung 'byin par byed cing*/

chos nyid kyi khyad par mthong ba la bar du gcod par byed pa sgom spangs su gtogs pa gang yin pa de ni sgom lam rtse sbyor rim can du byung ba rnams kyis rim gyis spong bar byed de/ sgom spang gi nang tshan gzhi kun nas nyon mongs kyi rnam rtog ces bya ba rnams ni/ bag la nyal gyi nyon sgrib la brten nas gnas pa'i rnam rtog yin cing*/ sa brgyad pa yan cad la ni de dag kyang mtshan ma med pa'i rnam rtog kho nar shes par bya'o/ /spang bya rnam rtog rang gi yul snang ba dang bcas pa ni/ gdod ma nas ma grub cing*/ med bzhin du snang pa yin pa la de ltar rtogs pa ni spangs pa'i don yin te/ de skad du/ 'gog pa med pa'i rang bzhin la/ /mthong zhes bya ba'i lam gyis ni/ /ci zhig nyams shing ci zhig thob/ /rnam par rtog rigs ci zhig zad/ /skye med rnam pa ci zhig thob/ /gzhan gyi chos rnams kyang yod la/ /shes bya la yang ston pa yi/ /sgrib pa zad par brjod pa gang*/ /de la kho bos mtshar du brtsis/ /'di la bsal bya ci yang med/ /bzhag par bya ba cung zad med/ /yang dag nyid la yang dag blta/ /yang dag mthong na rnam par grol/ /ces gsungs pa yin no/ /mthong bas spang bar bya ba rnams ni/ dus gcig tu spong ba yin la/ sgom pas spang bar bya ba rnams ni rim gyis spong zhing yon tan yang rim gyis gang bar 'gyur te/ ji skad du/ yams nad 'di rnams zad nas ni/ /yun rings lon nas dbugs phyin ltar/ /rnam pa kun tu 'gro ba yi/ /bde sgrub yon tan phun tshogs kun/ /rgya mtsho che la chu bo bzhin/ /'bras bu mchog gis dpa' ba yi/ /sems dpa' chen po de la ni/ /rnam pa kun tu bsten par byed/ /ces 'byung ngo*/ /mthar gyis pas mthar chags su sgom pas ni/ rang rang gi ngo skal gyi spang bya phyin ci log gi bag chags phra mo rnams rim gyis sbyong bar byed do/ /skad cig ma ni de ltar bag chags byang ba'i 'bras bu yin te/

sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang phal cher 'dra ba/ skad cig gnyis par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par byed pa'i lam/ bar chad med pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin ces bya ba/ ma rig bag chags kyi sa rtsa ba nas 'joms par byed pa de yin no/ /'bras bu chos sku'i mngon par rtogs pa la/ sku gsum dang 'phrin las te bzhi'o/ /de la ngo bo nyid sku ni/ chos dbyings shin tu dri ma med pa dag pa gnyis ldan de/ legs pa'i yon tan gyi chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin dang*/ ngo bo dang*/ rnam par 'dug pa'o/ /de ltar yang*/ thub pa'i ngo bo nyid sku ni/ /zag pa med pa'i chos gang dag /thob gyur rnam kun rnam dag pa/ /de dag rang bzhin mtshan nyid can/ /ces gsungs pa te/ legs pa'i yon tan gyi chos de dag thams cad kyang*/ don dam gdod ma yin pas rang bzhin gyi ngo bor gnas kyi/ kun rdzob rnam 'gyur gyi tshul gyis ma yin no/ /'dir zag pa med pa'i chos zhes pa'i rgyas bshad la/ byang chub phyogs mthun sogs zag med kyi sde tshan nyer gcig gsungs pa yin pas/ gzhung gi gnas skabs de gnyis ngo bo nyid sku dang*/ rtogs pa ye shes chos sku zhes/ don tshan so sor 'byed pa ni mdo dang bstan bcos kyi dgongs pa ma yin no/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ni/ mtshan dpe mtha' yas pas nye bar brgyan pa'i ye shes kyi sku/ chos kyi 'khor lo ma lus pa cig char bskor ba po yin la/ sprul pa'i sku ni 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas par/ sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa rgyun mi 'chad bar 'byung ba rnams te/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis ston pa sogs la mchog gi sprul pa'i sku zhes yongs su grags so/ 'dir ni de tsam zhig rnam par gzhag mod kyi/ sku gsum gyi rang bzhin ni sngar bshad zin pa ltar ro/ /'phrin las ni/ sems can thams cad la 'jug ste/ rang gi skal ba dang 'tsham par/ mngon par mthong ba'i bde ba dang*/

nges par legs pa'i phan pa la 'god cing*/ mthar thug gi 'phrin las ni sangs rgyas rang nyid kyi go 'phang la 'god pa'o/ /'o na mtshan dpe la sogs pa'i yon tan ni longs sprul gyi skabs su bshad cing*/ ngo bo nyid sku'am chos sku'i yon tan gyi skabs su med pas/ rang bzhin gyi mtshan nyid can gyi yon tan min la/ de ma yin pa'i phyir rang bzhin gyi grub pa'i bde gshegs snying po la/ mtshan dpe yod par 'dod pa shin tu mi 'thad do snyam pa dang*/ rgyud bla ma las kyang*/ gzugs sku la mtshan gyi yon tan so gnyis dang*/ chos sku la stobs sogs so gnyis bshad pas kyang ngo snyam na/ yon tan gyi sde tshan 'di rnams ni/ yang dag pa'i ngag dang*/ yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' dang*/ yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba dang*/ de bzhin du skye ba la dbang ba dang*/ so so yang dag pa rig pa bzhi dang*/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang*/ sku dang gsung gi spyod lam bsrung ba mi mnga' ba dang*/ lha'i mig dang*/ rna ba dang*/ sku la 'khrul ba mi mnga' ba dang*/ gsung ca co mi mnga' ba la sogs pa'i yon tan de dag kyang sku'i snang ba dang gsung gi snang ba med na khungs stongs par 'gyur la/ zad par dang zil gnon la sogs pa yang*/ sku dang 'brel pa las 'byung gi sku dang gsung gi snang ba med pa'i rig pa rnam pa rnam med la ci zhig 'byung ste/ de dag gi spyod yul mthong ba po med pa'i phyir ro/ /sku'i spyod lam bsrung ba mi mnga' ba dang*/ sku la 'khrul ba mi mnga' ba de dag chos sku'i yon tan yin phyin/ 'khrul ba med rgyu'i sku de dang*/ bsrung ba med rgyu'i sku'i spyod lam de/ zhal phyag rnam pa'i gzugs brnyan can mtshan dpe can gyi sku la mi 'jog na/ mtshan dpe sogs gang yang med pa'i sku gzugs 'jim pa'i gong bu 'dra ba zhig yod dam ci/ ci ste chos kyi sku la sku lus med na ni/ de la 'khrul ba yod med kyi dpyad gzhi stongs te/ gzhan du na/

ri bong gi rwa la gas chag med pa yang ci'i phyir chos sku'i yon tan du mi 'jog sku de gzugs sku kho na yin na ni/ yon tan de dag kyang de nyid kyi spyod lam la sogs pa'i yon tan yin par 'gyur gyi chos sku'i ci'i phyir yin chos sku'i nus mthu las gyur pas so snyam na ni/ mtshan dpe yang ci'i phyir chos sku'i mthu las ma byung*/ des na gang dag sangs rgyas ci med cang med du 'dod pa dang*/ sangs rgyas bya ba kha mig gcig med kyi/ mi skya'i skabs kyi rig pa hol thom me ba 'di ka chos sku zad ma yin cing*/ 'thab brtsod dang 'khrug long dang*/ nyo tshong dang*/ zhing las dang*/ zas gos dang*/ 'khrig pa'i longs spyod sogs don du gnyer ba/ nyon mongs dang rnam rtog gi lang long 'di ka chos sku'i rang 'od yin la/ sbyin sogs dang lha sgom pa la sogs pa gnas lugs las gol ba yin pas sgom du mi rung ngo*/ /zhes skad gsangs mthon pos lta ba mtho mtho mor sgraug pa de ni/ mtshan dpe can gyi sku dang*/ gsung chos kyi sgra dbyangs dang*/ thugs shes bya thams cad rig pa'i ye shes dang 'phṛn las blang dor gyi gnas rnams/ rnam rtog tsam dang blos byas tsam yin no zhes mchog rnams g.yas chung ngu phab cing*/ nyon mongs rang ga ma yar bstod nas sangs rgyas yin par thag gcod pa ste/ dge chos sun 'byin cing*/ mi dge ba'i zhabs tog byed pa'i bla ma skyes chen bye ba khrag khrig byung ba 'di rnams ni/ gzhan 'phrul bdag po'i gcan pa kho nar nges so/ /yang 'di skad ces/ yon tan de dag ni chos sku dngos ma yin gyi/ chos sku'i nus pa la brten nas byung ba yin pa'i phyir 'dir smos so zhes pa 'di ni bden dgos te/ gzhan du na zad par la sogs pa 'khrul shes yin pa'i phyir chos sku dngos te ga la yin ce na/ chos kyi sku'i yon tan kyi sku dang*/ gsung dang*/ zhing khams dang*/ mtshan dpe dang*/

zad par zil gnon la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod yul rnams kyang 'khrul ba ma yin te yang dag pa'i ye shes nyag cig go /gdul bya gzhan snang du/ sa chu la sogs pa ston pa yang*/ kun rdzob bden pa la bltos te ni 'khrul snang du mi 'jog ste/ so so skye bo rnams kyi las ngan gyi 'bras bu ni ma 'khrul la/ 'phags pa rnams kyi ye shes kyi spyod yul ni 'khrul lo zhes bya ba ni/ 'khrul ma 'khrul gyi dbye ba go log tu gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /ci ste las snang 'di kun rdzob tu bden na ni/ gdul bya'i don du 'gyur ba'i tshe/ ri dang chu la sogs pa 'gro ba spyi mthun gyi snang ngor brtan par gnas pa yang mthong bas de dag bden cing gzhan dag mi bden no/ /zhes dbye ba ci'i phyir nus/ de lta bas na rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la dad pa mi 'dor ba shin tu gal che'o/ /shin tu spros pas chog go /da ni mngon par rtogs pa'i don de dag nyid/ shes rab kyi pha rol phyin pa'i snying po'i mdo 'di nyid kyi tshig dang rim pa bzhin du sbyar bar bya'o/ /de yang de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus zhes pa nas/ gang ba med pa'o zhes pa'i bar gyis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid bstan pa yin te/ dri ba dri lan kyi skabs su shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo spyad pa spyod par 'dod pa/ zhes pas sems bskyed dang*/ ji ltar bslab pa zhes dris pa la 'di ltar rnam par blta bar bya ste/ zhes gdams pas ni/ gdams ngag bstan pa dang*/ rang bzhin gyis stong par yang dag par rjes su blta'o/ /zhes pas ni sbyor lam gyi dmigs rnam bstan pas nges 'byed cha mthun no/ /de ltar yang*/ dmigs pa mi rtag la sogs pa/ /bden pa'i rten can de yi ni/ /rnam pa mngon zhen la sogs 'gogaces gsungs so/ /gzugs stong pa'o zhes pa la sogs pas sgrub pa'i rten chos dbyings bstan to/ /de lta bas na chos thams cad stong pa nyid de sogs kyis sgrub pa'i dmigs pa dang*/

mtshan nyid med pa sogs kyis spong ba chen po la sogs pa ched du bya ba chen po gsum bstan to/ /bri ba med cing gang ba med pa zhes pas/ spang bya sgrib pa rang bzhin gyis ma dmigs shing*/ thob bya lam dang yon tan thams cad kyang sgyu ma lta bur shes nas/ bri gang bsal bzhag med par rtogs kyang tshogs gnyis rlabs po che rgyun mi 'chad par spyod pa'i sgrub pa bstan pa yin te/ 'dir sgrub pa'i ngo bo tsam zhig bstan pas/ dbye ba go cha'i sgrub pa/ 'jug pa'i sgrub pa/ tshogs kyi sgrub pa/ nges 'byung sgrub pa'i khyad par rnams shugs la bstan pa yin no/ /de ltar na rnam mkhyen mtshon byed kyi chos bcu po bstan pas mtshon bya rnam mkhyen bstan pa yin la/ der ma zad zab mo'i mtshan nyid rnam pa brgyad dang ldan pa'i sher phyin bstan pa kho nas kyang don dam pa'i rnam mkhyen chos kyi sku nyid gsal bar bstan pa yin no/ /stong pa nyid la gzugs med ces pa la sogs pas phung po dang skye mched dang khams rnams rang bzhin med par bstan pa 'dis ni/ lam shes kyi dmigs pa'i yul gsal bar bstan pas/ de ltar rtogs pa'i lam shes nyid nges par bstan pa yin la/ dbye ba'i tshig mi gsal yang mthong lam dang*/ sgrub pa sgom lam gnyis rnam dag dang bcas pa shugs la bstan pa yin no/ /ma rig pa med sogs rten 'brel bcu gnyis lugs 'byung lugs zlog bkag pas ni/ dngos bstan gnyen po'i phyogs kyi gzhi shes kyi dmigs rnams gsal bar bstan pa yin la/ kun nas nyon mongs kyi rten 'brel stong nyid du bstan pa'i shugs la/ nyan rang gi gzhi shes kyang 'phangs pa yin no/ /de bzhin du sdug bsngal ba dang sogs kyis/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i rnam pa rnams bstan te/ gzhi shes lam shais kyi rnam pa rnams ni/ bden bzhi spros pa dang bral ba'i rnam par 'dus la/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa rnams ni ye shes zhes par 'dus so/

/thob pa med pa dang ma thob pa med pa zhes pas ni/ mi gnas pa'i sbyor ba dngos su bstan cing*/ de'i khyad chos mi sbyor ba'i sbyor ba sogs shugs la bstan la/ thob pa zhes pa yon tan dang 'bras bu thob pa kho na la 'chad pa ltar na/ slob pa phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs la sogs pa/ don tshan phyi ma bzhi yang don gyis bstan par 'gyur ro/ /thob pa med pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo la brten cing gnas zhes pa ni/ mi gnas pa'i sbyor ba'i rgyun shin tu goms shing byang ba la gnas pa'i don te/ rtse mo'i sbyor ba dngos yin la/ sgrib pa med cing skrag pa med ces pas mthong sgom gyi rtse sbyor gyis/ spang bya gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa spong tshul bstan te/ chos nyid mthong ba la bsgrib pa'i mthong spangs med cing*/ chos nyid kho na la gnas mi nus par skrag pa'i sgom spangs med do zhes dngos su bstan la/ rtse sbyor gyi rtags dang*/ log sgrub spong ba rnams kyang shugs la 'phangs so/ /phyin ci logs las shin tu 'das nas mya ngan las 'das pa'i mthar phyin to/ /zhes pas mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba bstan te/ bslab pa gsum la phyin ci log pa'i gnyen por pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang*/ rtag pa la mi rtag par 'dzin pa sogs log lta bzhi'i gnyen por rjes dran drug dang*/ mi rtag pa la rtag par 'dzin pa la sogs pa lta ba phyin ci log gi gnyen por bdag med gnyis kyi don la sgom pa dngos med ngo bo nyid kyi mthar gyis pa gsungs te/ spyir mthar gyis pa'i rnam pa la tshad bzung du med de/ sbyor ba snga ma gnyis kyi rnam pa thams cad las 'di rnam pa mang mod kyang*/ chos bcu gsum gyi grangs su bcad pa ni/ phyin ci log gi gnyen por dgongs pa'i phyir te/ phyin ci log las shin tu 'das zhes pas mthar gyis pa bstan to/ /dus gsum du sogs pa skad cig ma'i sbyor ba ste sangs rgyas thams cad gang bsgom pa la brten nas/

dngos su sangs rgyas thob pa 'gyur ba'i lam shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de ni/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba yin te/ rgyun mtha'i ye shes kyi ming gi rnam grangs so/ /sngags kyi phan yon rnams ni chos sku mdzad pa dang bcas pa ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngags zhes pa mdor bstan dang*/ rig pa chen po zhes pa ngo bo nyid sku dang*/ bla na med pa zhes pa longs sku dang*/ 'jig rten khams su mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ni sprul pa'i sku ste sku gsum dang*/ sdug bsngal thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa ni 'phrin las te chos sku'i mdzad pa'o/ /chos kyi sku 'gyur med yongs grub de ni/ mnyam gzhag ye shes 'khrul ba dang bral bas nyams su myong bya yin pa'i phyir/ bden par grub pa yin la/ brdzun pa kun rdzob 'khor ba'i chos thams cad las gdod nas grol ba'i phyir/ mi rdzun pa ste brdzun pa ma yin pa'i don no/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngags zhes pa ni/ 'phrin las kyi khyad par chos sku'i rgyu mthun pa'i rigs sngags so/ kha cig sngags don la/ lam lnga dang sbyor ba ni skabs 'dir yang blang ste/ ga te ni song pa ste tshogs lam/ ga te gnyis pa ni sbyor lam/ pa ra ga te ni mthong lam ste/ pa ra zhes pa mchog ste 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir ro/ /pa ra sang ga te ni de bas kyang lhag pa yang dag par song ba'i ye shes te sgom lam mo/ /bo dhi ni byang chub ste 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa'o/ /zhes skyes bu dam pa 'ga' zhig gsung ngo*/ /da ni sher phyin snying po'i mdo 'di'i don gyi nying khu sgom rim gyi lag len cung zad brjod par bya ste/ de yang thub pa'i bstan pa la brtul zhugs yang dag par blangs nas/ theg pa chen po'i sde snod la thos bsam ci rigs par bya'o/ /tshe 'dir mang du thos pa kho na ma lcogs na yang*/ gong du ji skad bstan pa ltar mdo sde dam pa 'di nyid kyi/
