dngos bstan tshig don dang 'grel pa'i go ba rnams legs par rtogs shing*/ the tshom med pa blo la gsal po 'byung ba zhig nges par gal che'o/ khyad par stong pa nyid kyi lta ba dang*/ snying rje chen po dang*/ byang chub sems pa'i spyod pa rnams la nges pa rnyed pa dang*/ chos la yid ches pa dang dad pa brtan por gyur gyi bar du yang yang bsam pa gal che na/ de'i don du skyes bu gsum gyi rim pa lta bu sngon 'gror byas na legs so/ /de nas byang chub tu sems bskyed cing*/ 'grub na 'jug sems kyi sdom pa yang blang bar bya'o/ /spyir mdo sde'i rgyan las gsungs pa ltar/ dmigs pa'i sems drug dang yid la byed pa bcu gcig dang*/ sems gnas pa'i thabs dgu la sogs pa dgos kyang*/ 'dir don gyi snying po mdo tsam ni 'di lta bus bsgom par bya ste/ dang por gnas khang gtsang mar/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs dang mdo sde 'di'i glegs bam bzhugs su gsol/ mchod pa ji ltar 'os pa bshams/ khrus la sogs pa gtsang sbra dang ldan pas/ yan lag bdun pa dang*/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas te/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan par bya/ sna nas rlung lan gsum bsal/ dbugs rang babs su bzhag ste/ bdag gang la brten nas sgom zhing sgrub pa ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po'i mdo 'di'o/ /zhes yid la dran cing gzhan gang la yang ma yengs par/ 'di ltar bsam ste/ shau lo ka nyer lnga'i tshad tsam 'di ni sher phyin snying po'i mdo yin no/ /bdag ni 'di la brten nas sangs rgyas sgrub bo snyam pa de nyid lan brgya tsam dran par byas nas/ bar der dge ba byang chub tu bsngos te/ khams gseng zhing*/ 'chag pa la sogs pa ji ltar bde bas ngal gsos la/ yang sngar gyi tshad tsam du bsgom par bya'o/ /de ltar thun bcu tsam byas pas zhag gcig la/ yid la byed pa stong phrag gcig tu 'gyur la/ thun gyi tshad nyi grib la sogs pa nges pa can du byas nas/

gal te khams dub na nyi ma gcig gam gnyis sam gsum du thun thams cad nas cha phri ba'am/ thun 'ga' zhig cha phri ba'am/ gang mi bde ba'i thun 'jog pa lta bu ji ltar 'os pas ngal gso/ thog ma'i thun gyi tshad ni ring thung rang gi blo dang 'tsham par sbyar bas rung ste/ de nas cung zad goms shing sgom pa la spro bar gyur pa'i tshe/ thun cung zad cung zad bskyed cing*/ yang khams log na cung zad cung zad phri'o/ /de la cung zad goms pa na/ mdo sde 'di la ni dang por gleng gzhi dang*/ de nas gleng bslang ba dang*/ de nas zab mo brgyad kyi stong nyid dang*/ mkhas par bya ba drug phan yon dang bcas pa dang yi rang gi bar du yod do/ /don 'di ni bdag gi bsgom bya yin pa sogs gong bzhin bsam ste/ 'di dmigs pa

: zhib £¨¡¶ dzaṃ ¡· theb £© pa'i phyir/ dmigs thengs re la snga ma las yun gsum bzhi tsam gyis ring bar 'jog dgos te/ thun re'i nang du lan bzhi bcu 'am lnga bcu la sogs pa bsgom par bya'o/ /'di yang ring du goms nas/ thun so so'i mgor sngon bzhin bsgoms te/ dngos gzhi'i skabs su/ mdo 'di las bstan pa'i zab mo brgyad dang ldan pa'i stong nyid ces bya ba ni/ gzhan zhig yod pa ma yin pa 'di lta ste/ bdag gzhan snod bcud kyi chos sna tshogs par snang ba 'di/ rang sems 'khrul ba'i snang ba tsam la shar ba ma gtogs cung zad kyang ngo bos med pa nyid do/ /zhes yang yang bsams shing*/ de ltar bsam pa lan nyer gcig sogs song ba na/ yang sngar gyi dmigs pa gnyis po sngon du 'gro ba'i bar byas nas de 'dra nyer gcig sgom pa lta bu bya'o/ /de la cung zad goms na/ ma skyes pa la sogs pa'i rgyu mtshan gcig gam gnyis sam mang po rang gi blo'i 'khobs dang bstun nas dran par byed pa yang bsnon no/ /yang de bzhin du phung po zhes bya ba ni rang gzhan snong bcud kyi steng na gnas 'di dang 'di dag yin la/ de thams cad kyang gdod ma nas ma grub po zhes gcig du bral la sogs pa'i rgyu mtshan cung zad dran par byas te 'dun pa shugs drag po sbyangs/ de bzhin du khams dang skye mched dang rten 'brel dang bden bzhi dang*/ gnas dang gnas min la yang sbyong dgos te/ blo rgya che na rim can du sgom/ rgya chung na de dag las gang yang rung ba blo la bde zhing gsal ba cig sgom ste/ de dag ni sngon 'gro 'jug pa'i rim pa yin no/ /da ni dngos gzhi la/ yan lag bdun pa nas/ mdo don bsam pa'i bar tshar gcig song nas/ rang gzhan snod bcud 'khor 'das thams cad ji ltar snang ba 'di sgyu ma lta bu yin/ yang dag par na cung zad kyang ma grub bo/ /gcig du bral la sogs pa cung zad gcig dran par byas nas nges shes kyang bskyed/

de ltar rang gzhan snang ba thams cad kyi steng du bsnyams pa'i tshe/ gang yang ma grub pa de la che re mnyam par gzhag tshul des bden med du bsam pa dang*/ nges shes bskyed pa dang*/ ngang la 'jog pa gsum po de dag yang yang bskyar te/ bcu 'am nyer gcig la sogs pa ji ltar rigs pa song ba na/ yang mdo don dran pa sngon dus song pas dmigs pa nyer gcig la sogs pa bya'o/ /de dag gi bar bar du sher phyin gyi mdo 'di'i phan yon dang*/ gsung ba po sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dran nas/ sangs rgyas dang chos spyi dang*/ dgos su 'di la mos gus dung nge ba re bsgom/ sems can 'khrul ba rnams la snying rje lhag par re yang gsal btab/ de ltar gnad du 'gro bar byung na/ zhag bdun bdun tsam re nas/ bsam med du mnyam par 'jog pa de cung zad cung zad re yun ring du btang*/ de yang mi rtog pa'i blo ngo na ci yang ma yin pa'i rnam pa de 'char gyi 'dug na de yun ring du gtong ba yin gyi/ shes pa mi gsal ba mun mun par yod na/ shes pa bzo med du bzhag kyang mi phan pas/ gnad snga ma gnyis la shugs bskyed pa gal che/ de dag gi skabs su sgom thun yun ṛng por thub na thun 'tshams su ngal gso zhing*/ chos spyod kyi rim : pa cung zad £¨¡¶ dzaṃ ¡· bcu mdo tsam £© re byas pas chog la/ thun yun thung ngu las mi byed na/ thun mtshams kyi chos spyod gal che ste/ de la thun mtshams kyi spyod pa ni spyir chos spyod sgo thams cad nas yin kyang*/ khyad par mdo sde 'di nyid yi ger 'bri ba dang*/ 'di'i gleg bam la mchod pa dang*/ gleg bam klog pa dang*/ kha don du byed pa dang*/ mdo'i don 'chad pa'am/ nyan pa'am/ bsam pa la sogs pa'o/ /de dag goms nas/ sems gnas par dgu'i rim pas stong nyid la dmigs pa'i zhi gnas dang*/ rang sems kyi ngo bo nyid dang*/ khyad par yang yang brtsal bas cha shas tsam gyi lhag mthong la brten nas stong pa nyid la nges pa rnyed par 'gyur ba sogs spyi dang 'dra'o/

/de'i tshe rang bzhin gang du yang ma grub pa'i ngang nas sems kyi gsal snang dang*/ ting nge 'dzin kyi spyod yul kyi gzugs na tshogs 'byung ste/ gtso bor mi rtog pa'i stobs las 'byung gi dpyad pa'i skabs su 'byung ba ni nyung ngo*/ /de ni sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba dang*/ rang bzhin rnam pa thams cad pa yin pa'i rtags su ngo sprad par bya'o/ /sgom tshul gnad kyi snying po de ltar bzung nas/ rnal 'byor gy-i sa bzhi'am/ theg pa chen po'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam gtan bzhi'am/ rnal 'byor gyi sa lnga la sogs pa ji ltar rigs pa sbyar te bshad pas rung zhing*/ dngos gzhi'i skabs su dpyad mthar mi rtog par 'jog pa dang*/ thog ma'i dus su dpyad pa byed cing phyis mi rtog pa kho nar 'jog pa dang*/ thog ma nyid nas kyang mi rtog pa nyid la 'jug pa dang*/ sngags kyi theg pa dang go mthun du sgrub tshul sogs/ thams cad kyang gang zag so so'i blo dang bstun na legs par 'gyur ba sha stag go /shin tu zab pa'i mdo sde 'di/ /rang blo'i stobs dang sbyar te bshad/ /ha cang mang na rtogs dkar 'gyur/ /dka' 'grel tshul du mdo tsam bkrol/ /dge ba 'di yis sems can thams cad/ /sangs rgyas rtag pa'i go 'phangs thob gyur/ /de srid du yang legs bshad mang pos/ /phan bde phyogs kun khyab par gyur cig /ces bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pharol tu phyin pa'i snying po'i 'grel pa/ sngon med legs bshad ces bya ba 'di yang*/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas sbyar ba'o/ /mdo 'di la dri med bshes gnyen gyi 'grel pa rgya 'grel yin nges bstan pa snga dar la 'gyur ba de dang*/ de la 'grel bshad rngog lo chen pos mdzad pa dang*/ de gnyis kyi dgongs 'grel klags chog ma/ ar byang chub ye shes kyis mdzad pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das rig ral gyi tshig nyung la don bzang ba'i 'grel chung zhig dang*/ rong ston shākya rgyal mtshan gyi 'grel pa dang*/

mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan shākya mchog ldan gyi 'grel pa dang*/ bstan 'gyur du chug pa la/ jo bo rjes mdzad zer ba'i 'grel pa legs po zhig dang*/ dz+nyā na mi tris mdzad zer ba dang*/ pra shāsta s+ya nas mdzad zer ba dang*/ mahā dza nas mdzad zer ba rnams kyang snang ngo*/ /phyi ma 'dis gzhan stong gi tshul du yang 'grel zhing*/ de dag phal cher bshad sgros dri med bshes gnyen gyi 'grel chen dang phyogs mthun rung ngo*/ /gang ltar mkhas pa rnams kyi dpyad gzhir gyur pa'i 'grel pa de dag mthong zhing*/ gzhan yang rtse thang 'bum ram pa'i ṭī ka sogs blo gsar ba'i rnam rtog 'ga' re dang*/ bal po a su'i ngag sgros bstan 'gyur du chud pa cig dang*/ lce sgom ljong pas mdzad pa dang*/ gzhan yang bar skabs su byung ba'i phyag rdzogs zhi byed kyi lugs su bkral ba sus byas mi shes pa sna tshogs dang*/ dngos grub dpal 'bar bas rang gi yon tan sgrog pa kho nar lhur blangs pa'i ṭika chung sogs phyis byung gi ston sgom du 'dod pa sna tshogs pas sbyar ba'i 'grel pa shob thag can 'ad 'ud mang po yang snang ngo*/ /'dir ni bi ma la'i bzhed pa sogs su bkod pa ma gtogs gzhan de dag gang gi yang rjes su ma 'brangs par/ rang blo'i stobs kyis bshad pa'o/ /'o na paṇ+ḍi ta dang lo tsā ba chen po dang*/ sde snod 'dzin pa'i dbang phyug rnams kyis bshad pa byas zin pa'i phyir/ khyod kyis 'dir rnam bshad byed mi dgos la/ de dag dang bshad sgros mi mthun par byed pa yang 'os pa ma yin te/ chen po dag gi gsung la gras btod pa ni smra kham ha cang ches so snyam na/ spyir gzhan la phan pa'i rgyur kho bos rnam bshad byed dgos pa ma yin pa dang*/ de dag bas bdag cag blo gros kyi stobs mchog tu gyur pa yang ma yin pa dang*/ de dag gi bsod nams dang ye shes dang*/ tshul khrims kyi tshogs la/ bdag cag gi char yang skrun pa nus pa ma yin pa ni bden no/

/'on kyang rang gi blo gros goms pa'i phyir byed pa dang*/ ches che ba dag gis ni gzhung phra mo dag la che thang du ma mdzad pa yang snang zhing*/ blo gros chung bas kyang bsgrims pa na/ blo chen dag gis ma rnyed pa'i legs bshad ci rigs pa rnyed pa yang srid pa ni yin no/ /de dang gi yon tan la mchog tu gus pa dang*/ sku drin dran pa ni yod mod kyang*/ de dag des bshad pa gang la gnod byed gsal bar mthong ba dang*/ de dag gis ma bshad pa dag la yang rtags dang rgyu mtshan tshad ma mthong ba'i nges shes skyes pa'i tshe/ rkyen gang gis kyang zlog par ma nus te 'di tsam zhig smra ba la nyes pa ci yang med do/ /bdag cag 'phags pa'i blo can ma yin pas 'khrul bar smras su zin kyang 'os yin cing*/ phyogs 'dzin tsam gyi chags sdang ma yin par nges pa nyid du nor bar shes na ni/ kho bo cag gi bshad pa 'di yang ci bder spongs shig dang*/ bdag gi khro ba dang 'khon pa'i sems bskyed par mi byed do ci ste lung rigs gsal zhing nges pa yod na kho bos kyang lan par bgyi'o/ /stod lungs rgya dmar ba chen po'i zhal na re/ ma rabs mtho sar phyin pa dag /gzhan gyis byas la bskyor 'byin bzhin/ /dam pa'i legs bshad spangs nas ni/ /gzhan du rnam 'jog mi rigs mo/ /rnam dag yid ches ma skyes pas/ /dbang med rnam dpyod 'di ltar rig /ces dang*/ rje btsun dam pa mkhas rnams kyi/ /bzhed dang mi mthun mang bshad kyang*/ /bram ze gtsang sbra kun spyod bzhin/ /rnam dpyod rtog ge pa yi tshul/ /des na mkhas rnams mi mnyes med/ /bla ma dag gi drin yin mod/ /rang gi sbyang ba'i khyad las kyang*/ /rnam dpyod rtog ge sems la shar/ /dkyus sa bstan pa'i rta bzhin du/ /rtog dpyod yul la kha mi thub/ /gzhung mang gyur kyang rang dbang med/ /skye bo blo yin nor ldan rnams/ /phyogs 'dzin spangs pa'i yid kyis dpyod/ /skal ldan 'di la dga' mchog skye/

/zhes gsungs pa ltar bdag kyang smra ste/ blun po'i dad pa phyogs gcig pas/ /dam pa snga ma'i gsungs rjes su/ /'brang na shin tu brling mod kyi/ /blo gros chung yang gnod byed dang*/ /sgrub byed tshad ma mthong ba'i tshe/ /smra ba po de ches bzang yang*/ /'gal ba'i rjes su 'jug ma 'dod/ /yang smras pa/ zhe sdang khro bas smras na yang*/ /dam pa rnams ni bzod mdzad na/ /gus pa'i sems ni ma btang bas/ /mi dgyes par ni ci la 'gyur/ /dngos dang brgyud pa'i slob ma la/ /gang gi blo gros mchog skyes pa/ /'di yang de de'i drin yin ces/ /gus pa'i tshul ni nyams pa med/ /rgyal po'i rgyal po'i blon po sogs/ /stobs dang bsod nams blo che yang*/ /de dag rnams kyis ma go ba/ /zhing pa blun pos rig pa'ang yod/ /de bzhin bdag gis 'dir yang ste/ /sngon med legs bshad gsar ba'i 'phreng*/ /blo ldan rnams kyi mgul rgyan du/ /byin pa 'di la yi rang byos/ /zhes pa'ang smras te rnam par bshad pa 'di gcig pur ma zad/ bdag cag gis nye bar sbyar ba'i bstan bcos thams cad la go dgos so/ /yang kha cig 'di skad du/ khyed brdzun du smra bar ma gyur cig chen po rnams kyis ma bshad pa'i legs bshad mang du smras so bya ba 'dug na/ khyed kyi smra ba 'di rnams kyi nang na/ sngon gzhan sus kyang ma bshad pa'i legs bshad ni gang yin/ de yang ston dgos so zhe na/ de la smras pa/ spyir dam pa snga ma dag gis gtan nas ma bshad pa'i legs bshad kho bo la yod pa ma yin te/ de 'dra ba ni yod kyang ngo mtshar mi che'o/ /'on kyang sher phyin snying po'i mdo 'di'i steng du/ brjod bya'i don zab mo 'di dang 'di yod do zhes ston pa na/ mdo 'di'i 'grel byed sngar byung dag gis ma bshad pa ni mang du yod do/ /de la thog mar 'di yin te/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i 'jig rten las 'das par bstod pa ni/ sher snying gi don 'grel khyad par can du 'dug pa la/

sngon chad de ltar yin pa'i kha skad tsam yang mi snang mod/ 'dir bstod pa des mdo 'di'i don legs par bshad de bkral ba ni sher snying gi 'grel pa sngon chad byung ba su la yang med cing ngo mtshar smad du byung ba'i legs bshad dang po'o/ /bsdus don gyi gnas skabs su/ gzugs stong pa'o zhes sogs zab mo'i mtshan nyid brgyad po gnas lugs spros bral dmigs pa'i yul gtan la 'bebs byed du 'chad pa dang zab mo brgyad po stong nyid gsum dang sbyar te 'chad pa ni gnyis pa'o/ /stong pa nyid la gzugs med ces sogs mkhas par bya ba'i dngos po drug dang sbyar te/ gnas lugs de sgom pa'i tshul dang sbyor ba ni gsum pa'o/ /de lta bas na zhes sogs de ltar bsgoms pa'i phan yon ston pa rnams kyis/ sa lam gi rim pa rgyud la skye tshul 'chad pa ni bzhi pa'o/ /yang shugs bstan gyi dbang du byas nas/ stong pa nyid la gzugs med ces pa nas phan yon gyi bar gyis/ bdag tu lta ba rnam pa bcu'i gnyen por/ gang zag gi bdag med rgyas pa bstan pa'i tshul du 'chad pa ni lnga pa'o/ /mdo tshig dum bu brgyad du byas nas/ dngos po brgyad 'chad par sbyar ba na/ shin tu gsal zhing 'grigs par byung ba 'di ni drug pa'o/ /'di ni rigs pa dang yang mthun te/ spros bral gyi stong nyid tsam ston pas/ mdo rgyas pa'i snying pa'i don 'dus pa'i phyir snying por 'jog na ni/ sum brgya pa la sogs pa yang ci'i phyir sher phyin gyi snying por mi 'gyur/ tshig nyung ba kho nas snying por 'gyur na ni/ 'di bas kyang yi ge gcig ma nyung ba'i phyir de la snying po tha snyad ci'i phyir mi sbyor/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mngon rtogs lam rim gyi gtso bo de/ dngos po brgyad kyi rim pa 'di yin na/ sbas don gyi tshul gyis de 'dra mi ston na ni/ mdo thams cad kyi snying po'i sgras brjod pa yang don med par 'gyur ro/

/de'i phyir 'di ni sher phyin gyi yan lag tsam gyi mdo ma yin te/ don gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa yang yin la/ rnam grangs kyi spros pa dor ba'i phyir snying po'o/ /yang sems bskyed dang gdams ngag la sogs pa nyams len sgrub pa'i don gyi rnam grangs bco brgyad/ tshig don la shin tu gsal bar 'byor bar bshad de/ 'di yang sngon med pa'i legs bshad bdun pa'o/ /mdo 'dis stong nyid bcu drug gam bco brgyad tshig zur gyis gsal bar thon pa'i tshul dang sgom pa rnam g.yeng gi rnam rtog bcu'i gnyen por 'chad pa 'di yang sngon med pa'i legs par bshad pa brgyad pa'o/ /'dir dngos bstan dang sbas don gnyis ka 'chad pa las thun mong rnams chabs gcig tu 'chad pa dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa rnams dngos bstan la sbas don ma 'dres shing*/ dngos bstan dang sbas don dmigs phyed par 'chad pa 'di yang sngon med pa'i legs par bshad pa ste dgu pa'o/ /gleng bslang ba'i skabs su/ phung lnga stong par sgom pa sher phyin la 'jug pa'i thabs su bshad pas/ sher phyin dngos dang stong kyang mi gcig par bsgrub pa dang*/ stong nyid gzugs sogs zhes sogs dang*/ bri gang med pa'i tshig dang*/ stong nyid khyad gzhir byas nas 'dus byas bkag pa dang*/ bden par shes par bya ste/ zhes pa ste khyad par gyi tshig lngas/ dbu ma'i mthar thug gzhan stong dbu ma chen po'i don gsal bar 'chad pa 'di ni bcu pa yin te/ de rnams kyi nang tshan las phye ba'i sngon med legs bshad kyi khyad par shin tu mang por 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir 'di ni dge legs phun sum tshogs pa rab tu 'phel bar byed pa'o/ /zhes pa'ang kun dga' snying pos 'phros don du brjod pa'o/ /dge legs 'phel// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po'i mdo rnam par bshad pa sngon med legs bshad bzhugs/ - PAGE 2 -- PAGE 3 -- PAGE 1 -
